1.he: מִ֭שְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן־דָּוִ֑ד מֶ֝֗לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

lines.text: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
Proverbs of Solomon, son of David, king of Israel:

1.he: לָדַ֣עַת חָכְמָ֣ה וּמוּסָ֑ר לְ֝הָבִ֗ין אִמְרֵ֥י בִינָֽה׃

lines.text: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
For knowing wisdom and instruction, For understanding sayings of intelligence,

1.he: לָ֭קַחַת מוּסַ֣ר הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃

lines.text: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
For receiving the instruction of wisdom, Righteousness, judgment, and uprightness,

1.he: לָתֵ֣ת לִפְתָאיִ֣ם עָרְמָ֑ה לְ֝נַ֗עַר דַּ֣עַת וּמְזִמָּֽה׃

lines.text: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man:
For giving to simple ones — prudence, To a youth — knowledge and discretion.

1.he: יִשְׁמַ֣ע חָ֭כָם וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶ֑קַח וְ֝נָב֗וֹן תַּחְבֻּל֥וֹת יִקְנֶֽה׃

lines.text: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
(The wise doth hear and increaseth learning, And the intelligent doth obtain counsels.)

1.he: לְהָבִ֣ין מָ֭שָׁל וּמְלִיצָ֑ה דִּבְרֵ֥י חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים וְחִידֹתָֽם׃

lines.text: to understand a proverb, and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
For understanding a proverb and its sweetness, Words of the wise and their acute sayings.

1.he: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה רֵאשִׁ֣ית דָּ֑עַת חָכְמָ֥ה וּ֝מוּסָ֗ר אֱוִילִ֥ים בָּֽזוּ׃

lines.text: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
Fear of Jehovah [is] a beginning of knowledge, Wisdom and instruction fools have despised!

1.he: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑יךָ וְאַל־תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ תּוֹרַ֥ת אִמֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
Hear, my son, the instruction of thy father, And leave not the law of thy mother,

1.he: כִּ֤י ׀ לִוְיַ֤ת חֵ֓ן הֵ֬ם לְרֹאשֶׁ֑ךָ וַ֝עֲנָקִ֗ים לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
For a graceful wreath [are] they to thy head, And chains to thy neck.

1.he: בְּנִ֡י אִם־יְפַתּ֥וּךָ חַ֝טָּאִ֗ים אַל־תֹּבֵֽא׃

lines.text: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
My son, if sinners entice thee be not willing.

1.he: אִם־יֹאמְרוּ֮ לְכָ֪ה אִ֫תָּ֥נוּ נֶאֶרְבָ֥ה לְדָ֑ם נִצְפְּנָ֖ה לְנָקִ֣י חִנָּֽם׃

lines.text: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lay in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
If they say, 'Come with us, we lay wait for blood, We watch secretly for the innocent without cause,

1.he: נִ֭בְלָעֵם כִּשְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים כְּי֣וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
We swallow them as Sheol — alive, And whole — as those going down [to] the pit,

1.he: כָּל־ה֣וֹן יָקָ֣ר נִמְצָ֑א נְמַלֵּ֖א בָתֵּ֣ינוּ שָׁלָֽל׃

lines.text: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
Every precious substance we find, We fill our houses [with] spoil,

1.he: גּ֭וֹרָ֣לְךָ תַּפִּ֣יל בְּתוֹכֵ֑נוּ כִּ֥יס אֶ֝חָ֗ד יִהְיֶ֥ה לְכֻלָּֽנוּ׃

lines.text: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse.”
Thy lot thou dost cast among us, One purse is — to all of us.'

1.he: בְּנִ֗י אַל־תֵּלֵ֣ךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אִתָּ֑ם מְנַ֥ע רַ֝גְלְךָ֗ מִנְּתִיבָתָֽם׃

lines.text: My son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
My son! go not in the way with them, Withhold thy foot from their path,

1.he: כִּ֣י רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם לָרַ֣ע יָר֑וּצוּ וִֽ֝ימַהֲר֗וּ לִשְׁפָּךְ־דָּֽם׃

lines.text: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
For their feet to evil do run, And they haste to shed blood.

1.he: כִּֽי־חִ֭נָּם מְזֹרָ֣ה הָרָ֑שֶׁת בְּ֝עֵינֵ֗י כָל־בַּ֥עַל כָּנָֽף׃

lines.text: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;
Surely in vain is the net spread out before the eyes of any bird.

1.he: וְ֭הֵם לְדָמָ֣ם יֶאֱרֹ֑בוּ יִ֝צְפְּנ֗וּ לְנַפְשֹׁתָֽם׃

lines.text: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
And they for their own blood lay wait, They watch secretly for their own lives.

1.he: כֵּ֗ן אָ֭רְחוֹת כָּל־בֹּ֣צֵֽעַ בָּ֑צַע אֶת־נֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלָ֣יו יִקָּֽח׃

lines.text: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
So [are] the paths of every gainer of dishonest gain, The life of its owners it taketh.

1.he: חָ֭כְמוֹת בַּח֣וּץ תָּרֹ֑נָּה בָּ֝רְחֹב֗וֹת תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ׃

lines.text: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
Wisdom in an out-place crieth aloud, In broad places she giveth forth her voice,

1.he: בְּרֹ֥אשׁ הֹמִיּ֗וֹת תִּ֫קְרָ֥א בְּפִתְחֵ֖י שְׁעָרִ֥ים בָּעִ֗יר אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ תֹאמֵֽר׃

lines.text: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
At the head of the multitudes she calleth, In the openings of the gates, In the city her sayings she saith:

1.he: עַד־מָתַ֣י ׀ פְּתָיִם֮ תְּֽאֵהֲב֫וּ פֶ֥תִי וְלֵצִ֗ים לָ֭צוֹן חָמְד֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים יִשְׂנְאוּ־דָֽעַת׃

lines.text: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?
'Till when, ye simple, do ye love simplicity? And have scorners their scorning desired? And do fools hate knowledge?

1.he: תָּשׁ֗וּבוּ לְֽת֫וֹכַחְתִּ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה אַבִּ֣יעָה לָכֶ֣ם רוּחִ֑י אוֹדִ֖יעָה דְבָרַ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם׃

lines.text: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
Turn back at my reproof, lo, I pour forth to you my spirit, I make known my words with you.

1.he: יַ֣עַן קָ֭רָאתִי וַתְּמָאֵ֑נוּ נָטִ֥יתִי יָ֝דִ֗י וְאֵ֣ין מַקְשִֽׁיב׃

lines.text: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
Because I have called, and ye refuse, I stretched out my hand, and none is attending,

1.he: וַתִּפְרְע֥וּ כָל־עֲצָתִ֑י וְ֝תוֹכַחְתִּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲבִיתֶֽם׃

lines.text: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
And ye slight all my counsel, And my reproof ye have not desired.

1.he: גַּם־אֲ֭נִי בְּאֵידְכֶ֣ם אֶשְׂחָ֑ק אֶ֝לְעַ֗ג בְּבֹ֣א פַחְדְּכֶֽם׃

lines.text: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,
I also in your calamity do laugh, I deride when your fear cometh,

1.he: בְּבֹ֤א כשאוה ׀ פַּחְדְּכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭אֵידְכֶם כְּסוּפָ֣ה יֶאֱתֶ֑ה בְּבֹ֥א עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם צָרָ֥ה וְצוּקָֽה׃

lines.text: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.
When your fear cometh as destruction, And your calamity as a hurricane doth come, When on you come adversity and distress.

1.he: אָ֣ז יִ֭קְרָאֻנְנִי וְלֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה יְ֝שַׁחֲרֻ֗נְנִי וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי׃

lines.text: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me;
Then they call me, and I do not answer, They seek me earnestly, and find me not.

1.he: תַּ֭חַת כִּי־שָׂ֣נְאוּ דָ֑עַת וְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לֹ֣א בָחָֽרוּ׃

lines.text: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.
Because that they have hated knowledge, And the fear of Jehovah have not chosen.

1.he: לֹא־אָב֥וּ לַעֲצָתִ֑י נָ֝אֲצ֗וּ כָּל־תּוֹכַחְתִּֽי׃

lines.text: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
They have not consented to my counsel, They have despised all my reproof,

1.he: וְֽ֭יֹאכְלוּ מִפְּרִ֣י דַרְכָּ֑ם וּֽמִמֹּעֲצֹ֖תֵיהֶ֣ם יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃

lines.text: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
And they eat of the fruit of their way, And from their own counsels they are filled.

1.he: כִּ֤י מְשׁוּבַ֣ת פְּתָיִ֣ם תַּֽהַרְגֵ֑ם וְשַׁלְוַ֖ת כְּסִילִ֣ים תְּאַבְּדֵֽם׃

lines.text: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
For the turning of the simple slayeth them, And the security of the foolish destroyeth them.

1.he: וְשֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֭י יִשְׁכָּן־בֶּ֑טַח וְ֝שַׁאֲנַ֗ן מִפַּ֥חַד רָעָֽה׃

lines.text: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
And whoso is hearkening to me dwelleth confidently, And [is] quiet from fear of evil!'

2.he: בְּ֭נִי אִם־תִּקַּ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן אִתָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
My son, if thou dost accept my sayings, And my commands dost lay up with thee,

2.he: לְהַקְשִׁ֣יב לַֽחָכְמָ֣ה אָזְנֶ֑ךָ תַּטֶּ֥ה לִ֝בְּךָ֗ לַתְּבוּנָֽה׃

lines.text: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
To cause thine ear to attend to wisdom, Thou inclinest thy heart to understanding,

2.he: כִּ֤י אִ֣ם לַבִּינָ֣ה תִקְרָ֑א לַ֝תְּבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
For, if for intelligence thou callest, For understanding givest forth thy voice,

2.he: אִם־תְּבַקְשֶׁ֥נָּה כַכָּ֑סֶף וְֽכַמַּטְמוֹנִ֥ים תַּחְפְּשֶֽׂנָּה׃

lines.text: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures:
If thou dost seek her as silver, And as hid treasures searchest for her,

2.he: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת אֱלֹהִ֣ים תִּמְצָֽא׃

lines.text: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.
Then understandest thou fear of Jehovah, And knowledge of God thou findest.

2.he: כִּֽי־יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה מִ֝פִּ֗יו דַּ֣עַת וּתְבוּנָֽה׃

lines.text: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
For Jehovah giveth wisdom, From His mouth knowledge and understanding.

2.he: וצפן לַ֭יְשָׁרִים תּוּשִׁיָּ֑ה מָ֝גֵ֗ן לְהֹ֣לְכֵי תֹֽם׃

lines.text: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
Even to lay up for the upright substance, A shield for those walking uprightly.

2.he: לִ֭נְצֹר אָרְח֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְדֶ֖רֶךְ חסידו יִשְׁמֹֽר׃

lines.text: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
To keep the paths of judgment, And the way of His saints He preserveth.

2.he: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין צֶ֣דֶק וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מֵישָׁרִ֗ים כָּל־מַעְגַּל־טֽוֹב׃

lines.text: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
Then understandest thou righteousness, And judgment, and uprightness — every good path.

2.he: כִּֽי־תָב֣וֹא חָכְמָ֣ה בְלִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝דַ֗עַת לְֽנַפְשְׁךָ֥ יִנְעָֽם׃

lines.text: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
For wisdom cometh into thy heart, And knowledge to thy soul is pleasant,

2.he: מְ֭זִמָּה תִּשְׁמֹ֥ר עָלֶ֗יךָ תְּבוּנָ֥ה תִנְצְרֶֽכָּה׃

lines.text: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
Thoughtfulness doth watch over thee, Understanding doth keep thee,

2.he: לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ רָ֑ע מֵ֝אִ֗ישׁ מְדַבֵּ֥ר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃

lines.text: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,
To deliver thee from an evil way, From any speaking froward things,

2.he: הַ֭עֹ֣זְבִים אָרְח֣וֹת יֹ֑שֶׁר לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת בְּדַרְכֵי־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

lines.text: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,
Who are forsaking paths of uprightness, To walk in ways of darkness,

2.he: הַ֭שְּׂמֵחִים לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת רָ֑ע יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ בְּֽתַהְפֻּכ֥וֹת רָֽע׃

lines.text: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,
Who are rejoicing to do evil, They delight in frowardness of the wicked,

2.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָרְחֹתֵיהֶ֣ם עִקְּשִׁ֑ים וּ֝נְלוֹזִ֗ים בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתָֽם׃

lines.text: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,
Whose paths [are] crooked, Yea, they are perverted in their ways.

2.he: לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ מֵאִשָּׁ֣ה זָרָ֑ה מִ֝נָּכְרִיָּ֗ה אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה׃

lines.text: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
To deliver thee from the strange woman, From the stranger who hath made smooth her sayings,

2.he: הַ֭עֹזֶבֶת אַלּ֣וּף נְעוּרֶ֑יהָ וְאֶת־בְּרִ֖ית אֱלֹהֶ֣יהָ שָׁכֵֽחָה׃

lines.text: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;
Who is forsaking the guide of her youth, And the covenant of her God hath forgotten.

2.he: כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה אֶל־מָ֣וֶת בֵּיתָ֑הּ וְאֶל־רְ֝פָאִ֗ים מַעְגְּלֹתֶֽיהָ׃

lines.text: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
For her house hath inclined unto death, And unto Rephaim her paths.

2.he: כָּל־בָּ֭אֶיהָ לֹ֣א יְשׁוּב֑וּן וְלֹֽא־יַ֝שִּׂ֗יגוּ אָרְח֥וֹת חַיִּֽים׃

lines.text: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
None going in unto her turn back, Nor do they reach the paths of life.

2.he: לְמַ֗עַן תֵּ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ טוֹבִ֑ים וְאָרְח֖וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃

lines.text: So you may walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
That thou dost go in the way of the good, And the paths of the righteous dost keep.

2.he: כִּֽי־יְשָׁרִ֥ים יִשְׁכְּנוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים יִוָּ֥תְרוּ בָֽהּ׃

lines.text: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
For the upright do inhabit the earth, And the perfect are left in it,

2.he: וּ֭רְשָׁעִים מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ וּ֝בוֹגְדִ֗ים יִסְּח֥וּ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

lines.text: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
And the wicked from the earth are cut off, And treacherous dealers plucked out of it!

3.he: בְּ֭נִי תּוֹרָתִ֣י אַל־תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י יִצֹּ֥ר לִבֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:
My son! my law forget not, And my commands let thy heart keep,

3.he: כִּ֤י אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים וּשְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּ֑ים וְ֝שָׁל֗וֹם יוֹסִ֥יפוּ לָֽךְ׃

lines.text: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
For length of days and years, Life and peace they do add to thee.

3.he: חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֗ת אַֽל־יַעַ֫זְבֻ֥ךָ קָשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל־גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל־ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
Let not kindness and truth forsake thee, Bind them on thy neck, Write them on the tablet of thy heart,

3.he: וּמְצָא־חֵ֖ן וְשֵֽׂכֶל־ט֑וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאָדָֽם׃

lines.text: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
And find grace and good understanding In the eyes of God and man.

3.he: בְּטַ֣ח אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְאֶל־בִּֽ֝ינָתְךָ֗ אַל־תִּשָּׁעֵֽן׃

lines.text: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
Trust unto Jehovah with all thy heart, And unto thine own understanding lean not.

3.he: בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ דָעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יְיַשֵּׁ֥ר אֹֽרְחֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
In all thy ways know thou Him, And He doth make straight thy paths.

3.he: אַל־תְּהִ֣י חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ יְרָ֥א אֶת־יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃

lines.text: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
Be not wise in thine own eyes, Fear Jehovah, and turn aside from evil.

3.he: רִ֭פְאוּת תְּהִ֣י לְשָׁרֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝שִׁקּ֗וּי לְעַצְמוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
Healing it is to thy navel, And moistening to thy bones.

3.he: כַּבֵּ֣ד אֶת־יְ֭הוָה מֵהוֹנֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מֵרֵאשִׁ֗ית כָּל־תְּבוּאָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase:
Honour Jehovah from thy substance, And from the beginning of all thine increase;

3.he: וְיִמָּלְא֣וּ אֲסָמֶ֣יךָ שָׂבָ֑ע וְ֝תִיר֗וֹשׁ יְקָבֶ֥יךָ יִפְרֹֽצוּ׃

lines.text: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
And filled are thy barns [with] plenty, And [with] new wine thy presses break forth.

3.he: מוּסַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה בְּנִ֣י אַל־תִּמְאָ֑ס וְאַל־תָּ֝קֹ֗ץ בְּתוֹכַחְתּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
Chastisement of Jehovah, my son, despise not, And be not vexed with His reproof,

3.he: כִּ֤י אֶ֥ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶאֱהַ֣ב יְהוָ֣ה יוֹכִ֑יחַ וּ֝כְאָ֗ב אֶת־בֵּ֥ן יִרְצֶֽה׃

lines.text: for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
For whom Jehovah loveth He reproveth, Even as a father the son He is pleased with.

3.he: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מָצָ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝אָדָ֗ם יָפִ֥יק תְּבוּנָֽה׃

lines.text: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
O the happiness of a man [who] hath found wisdom, And of a man [who] bringeth forth understanding.

3.he: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב סַ֭חְרָהּ מִסְּחַר־כָּ֑סֶף וּ֝מֵחָר֗וּץ תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃

lines.text: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
For better [is] her merchandise Than the merchandise of silver, And than gold — her increase.

3.he: יְקָ֣רָה הִ֭יא מפניים וְכָל־חֲ֝פָצֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ־בָֽהּ׃

lines.text: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
Precious she [is] above rubies, And all thy pleasures are not comparable to her.

3.he: אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים בִּֽימִינָ֑הּ בִּ֝שְׂמֹאולָ֗הּ עֹ֣שֶׁר וְכָבֽוֹד׃

lines.text: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
Length of days [is] in her right hand, In her left [are] wealth and honour.

3.he: דְּרָכֶ֥יהָ דַרְכֵי־נֹ֑עַם וְֽכָל־נְתִ֖יבוֹתֶ֣יהָ שָׁלֽוֹם׃

lines.text: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
Her ways [are] ways of pleasantness, And all her paths [are] peace.

3.he: עֵץ־חַיִּ֣ים הִ֭יא לַמַּחֲזִיקִ֣ים בָּ֑הּ וְֽתֹמְכֶ֥יהָ מְאֻשָּֽׁר׃

lines.text: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
A tree of life she [is] to those laying hold on her, And whoso is retaining her [is] happy.

3.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּחָכְמָ֥ה יָֽסַד־אָ֑רֶץ כּוֹנֵ֥ן שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם בִּתְבוּנָֽה׃

lines.text: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
Jehovah by wisdom did found the earth, He prepared the heavens by understanding.

3.he: בְּ֭דַעְתּוֹ תְּהוֹמ֣וֹת נִבְקָ֑עוּ וּ֝שְׁחָקִ֗ים יִרְעֲפוּ־טָֽל׃

lines.text: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
By His knowledge depths have been rent, And clouds do drop dew.

3.he: בְּ֭נִי אַל־יָלֻ֣זוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ נְצֹ֥ר תֻּ֝שִׁיָּ֗ה וּמְזִמָּֽה׃

lines.text: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion:
My son! let them not turn from thine eyes, Keep thou wisdom and thoughtfulness,

3.he: וְיִֽהְי֣וּ חַיִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְ֝חֵ֗ן לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
And they are life to thy soul, and grace to thy neck.

3.he: אָ֤ז תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לָבֶ֣טַח דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝רַגְלְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִגּֽוֹף׃

lines.text: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
Then thou goest thy way confidently, And thy foot doth not stumble.

3.he: אִם־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב לֹֽא־תִפְחָ֑ד וְ֝שָׁכַבְתָּ֗ וְֽעָרְבָ֥ה שְׁנָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
If thou liest down, thou art not afraid, Yea, thou hast lain down, And sweet hath been thy sleep.

3.he: אַל־תִּ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹ֑ם וּמִשֹּׁאַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים כִּ֣י תָבֹֽא׃

lines.text: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
Be not afraid of sudden fear, And of the desolation of the wicked when it cometh.

3.he: כִּֽי־יְ֭הוָה יִהְיֶ֣ה בְכִסְלֶ֑ךָ וְשָׁמַ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מִלָּֽכֶד׃

lines.text: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
For Jehovah is at thy side, And He hath kept thy foot from capture.

3.he: אַל־תִּמְנַע־ט֥וֹב מִבְּעָלָ֑יו בִּהְי֨וֹת לְאֵ֖ל ידיך לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

lines.text: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
Withhold not good from its owners, When thy hand [is] toward God to do [it].

3.he: אַל־תֹּ֘אמַ֤ר לרעיך ׀ לֵ֣ךְ וָ֭שׁוּב וּמָחָ֥ר אֶתֵּ֗ן וְיֵ֣שׁ אִתָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
Say not thou to thy friend, 'Go, and return, and to-morrow I give,' And substance with thee.

3.he: אַל־תַּחֲרֹ֣שׁ עַל־רֵעֲךָ֣ רָעָ֑ה וְהֽוּא־יוֹשֵׁ֖ב לָבֶ֣טַח אִתָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.
Devise not against thy neighbour evil, And he sitting confidently with thee.

3.he: אַל־תרוב עִם־אָדָ֣ם חִנָּ֑ם אִם־לֹ֖א גְמָלְךָ֣ רָעָֽה׃

lines.text: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
Strive not with a man without cause, If he have not done thee evil.

3.he: אַל־תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּאִ֣ישׁ חָמָ֑ס וְאַל־תִּ֝בְחַ֗ר בְּכָל־דְּרָכָֽיו׃

lines.text: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
Be not envious of a man of violence, Nor fix thou on any of his ways.

3.he: כִּ֤י תוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה נָל֑וֹז וְֽאֶת־יְשָׁרִ֥ים סוֹדֽוֹ׃

lines.text: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.
For an abomination to Jehovah [is] the perverted, And with the upright [is] His secret counsel.

3.he: מְאֵרַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה בְּבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע וּנְוֵ֖ה צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְבָרֵֽךְ׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
The curse of Jehovah [is] in the house of the wicked. And the habitation of the righteous He blesseth.

3.he: אִם־לַלֵּצִ֥ים הֽוּא־יָלִ֑יץ ולעניים יִתֶּן־חֵֽן׃

lines.text: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
If the scorners He doth scorn, Yet to the humble He doth give grace.

3.he: כָּ֭בוֹד חֲכָמִ֣ים יִנְחָ֑לוּ וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מֵרִ֥ים קָלֽוֹן׃

lines.text: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
Honour do the wise inherit, And fools are bearing away shame!

4.he: שִׁמְע֣וּ בָ֭נִים מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לָדַ֥עַת בִּינָֽה׃

lines.text: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
Hear, ye sons, the instruction of a father, And give attention to know understanding.

4.he: כִּ֤י לֶ֣קַח ט֭וֹב נָתַ֣תִּי לָכֶ֑ם תּֽ֝וֹרָתִ֗י אַֽל־תַּעֲזֹֽבוּ׃

lines.text: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
For good learning I have given to you, My law forsake not.

4.he: כִּי־בֵ֭ן הָיִ֣יתִי לְאָבִ֑י רַ֥ךְ וְ֝יָחִ֗יד לִפְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃

lines.text: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.
For, a son I have been to my father — tender, And an only one before my mother.

4.he: וַיֹּרֵ֗נִי וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֗י יִֽתְמָךְ־דְּבָרַ֥י לִבֶּ֑ךָ שְׁמֹ֖ר מִצְוֺתַ֣י וֶֽחְיֵֽה׃

lines.text: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
And he directeth me, and he saith to me: 'Let thy heart retain my words, Keep my commands, and live.

4.he: קְנֵ֣ה חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה בִינָ֑ה אַל־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח וְאַל־תֵּ֝֗ט מֵֽאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃

lines.text: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.
Get wisdom, get understanding, Do not forget, nor turn away From the sayings of my mouth.

4.he: אַל־תַּעַזְבֶ֥הָ וְתִשְׁמְרֶ֑ךָּ אֱהָבֶ֥הָ וְתִצְּרֶֽךָּ׃

lines.text: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
Forsake her not, and she doth preserve thee, Love her, and she doth keep thee.

4.he: רֵאשִׁ֣ית חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּבְכָל־קִ֝נְיָנְךָ֗ קְנֵ֣ה בִינָֽה׃

lines.text: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
The first thing [is] wisdom — get wisdom, And with all thy getting get understanding.

4.he: סַלְסְלֶ֥הָ וּֽתְרוֹמְמֶ֑ךָּ תְּ֝כַבֵּ֗דְךָ כִּ֣י תְחַבְּקֶֽנָּה׃

lines.text: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.
Exalt her, and she doth lift thee up, She honoureth thee, when thou dost embrace her.

4.he: תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭רֹאשְׁךָ לִוְיַת־חֵ֑ן עֲטֶ֖רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת תְּמַגְּנֶֽךָּ׃

lines.text: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
She giveth to thy head a wreath of grace, A crown of beauty she doth give thee freely.

4.he: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי וְקַ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י וְיִרְבּ֥וּ לְ֝ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים׃

lines.text: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
Hear, my son, and receive my sayings, And years of life [are] multiplied to thee.

4.he: בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ חָ֭כְמָה הֹרֵתִ֑יךָ הִ֝דְרַכְתִּ֗יךָ בְּמַעְגְּלֵי־יֹֽשֶׁר׃

lines.text: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
In a way of wisdom I have directed thee, I have caused thee to tread in paths of uprightness.

4.he: בְּֽ֭לֶכְתְּךָ לֹא־יֵצַ֣ר צַעֲדֶ֑ךָ וְאִם־תָּ֝ר֗וּץ לֹ֣א תִכָּשֵֽׁל׃

lines.text: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
In thy walking thy step is not straitened, And if thou runnest, thou stumblest not.

4.he: הַחֲזֵ֣ק בַּמּוּסָ֣ר אַל־תֶּ֑רֶף נִ֝צְּרֶ֗הָ כִּי־הִ֥יא חַיֶּֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
Lay hold on instruction, do not desist, Keep her, for she [is] thy life.

4.he: בְּאֹ֣רַח רְ֭שָׁעִים אַל־תָּבֹ֑א וְאַל־תְּ֝אַשֵּׁ֗ר בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ רָעִֽים׃

lines.text: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
Into the path of the wicked enter not, And be not happy in a way of evil doers.

4.he: פְּרָעֵ֥הוּ אַל־תַּעֲבָר־בּ֑וֹ שְׂטֵ֖ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וַעֲבֽוֹר׃

lines.text: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
Avoid it, pass not over into it, Turn aside from it, and pass on.

4.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יִֽ֭שְׁנוּ אִם־לֹ֣א יָרֵ֑עוּ וְֽנִגְזְלָ֥ה שְׁ֝נָתָ֗ם אִם־לֹ֥א יכשולו׃

lines.text: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
For they sleep not if they do not evil, And their sleep hath been taken violently away, If they cause not [some] to stumble.

4.he: כִּ֣י לָ֭חֲמוּ לֶ֣חֶם רֶ֑שַׁע וְיֵ֖ין חֲמָסִ֣ים יִשְׁתּֽוּ׃

lines.text: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
For they have eaten bread of wickedness, And wine of violence they drink.

4.he: וְאֹ֣רַח צַ֭דִּיקִים כְּא֣וֹר נֹ֑גַהּ הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וָ֝א֗וֹר עַד־נְכ֥וֹן הַיּֽוֹם׃

lines.text: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
And the path of the righteous [is] as a shining light, Going and brightening till the day is established,

4.he: דֶּ֣רֶךְ רְ֭שָׁעִים כָּֽאֲפֵלָ֑ה לֹ֥א יָ֝דְע֗וּ בַּמֶּ֥ה יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃

lines.text: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
The way of the wicked [is] as darkness, They have not known at what they stumble.

4.he: בְּ֭נִי לִדְבָרַ֣י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָה לַ֝אֲמָרַ֗י הַט־אָזְנֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
My son, to my words give attention, To my sayings incline thine ear,

4.he: אַל־יַלִּ֥יזוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׁ֝מְרֵ֗ם בְּת֣וֹךְ לְבָבֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.
Let them not turn aside from thine eyes, Preserve them in the midst of thy heart.

4.he: כִּֽי־חַיִּ֣ים הֵ֭ם לְמֹצְאֵיהֶ֑ם וּֽלְכָל־בְּשָׂר֥וֹ מַרְפֵּֽא׃

lines.text: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
For life they [are] to those finding them, And to all their flesh healing.

4.he: מִֽכָּל־מִ֭שְׁמָר נְצֹ֣ר לִבֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ תּוֹצְא֥וֹת חַיִּֽים׃

lines.text: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
Above every charge keep thy heart, For out of it [are] the outgoings of life.

4.he: הָסֵ֣ר מִ֭מְּךָ עִקְּשׁ֣וּת פֶּ֑ה וּלְז֥וּת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם הַרְחֵ֥ק מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

lines.text: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
Turn aside from thee a froward mouth, And perverse lips put far from thee,

4.he: עֵ֭ינֶיךָ לְנֹ֣כַח יַבִּ֑יטוּ וְ֝עַפְעַפֶּ֗יךָ יַיְשִׁ֥רוּ נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
Thine eyes do look straightforward, And thine eyelids look straight before thee.

4.he: פַּ֭לֵּס מַעְגַּ֣ל רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וְֽכָל־דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ יִכֹּֽנוּ׃

lines.text: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
Ponder thou the path of thy feet, And all thy ways [are] established.

4.he: אַֽל־תֵּט־יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול הָסֵ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מֵרָֽע׃

lines.text: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
Incline not [to] the right or to the left, Turn aside thy foot from evil!

5.he: בְּ֭נִי לְחָכְמָתִ֣י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָה לִ֝תְבוּנָתִ֗י הַט־אָזְנֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
My son! to my wisdom give attention, To mine understanding incline thine ear,

5.he: לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְזִמּ֑וֹת וְ֝דַ֗עַת שְׂפָתֶ֥יךָ יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃

lines.text: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.
To observe thoughtfulness, And knowledge do thy lips keep.

5.he: כִּ֤י נֹ֣פֶת תִּ֭טֹּפְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֣י זָרָ֑ה וְחָלָ֖ק מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן חִכָּֽהּ׃

lines.text: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
For the lips of a strange woman drop honey, And smoother than oil [is] her mouth,

5.he: וְֽ֭אַחֲרִיתָהּ מָרָ֣ה כַֽלַּעֲנָ֑ה חַ֝דָּ֗ה כְּחֶ֣רֶב פִּיּֽוֹת׃

lines.text: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
And her latter end [is] bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a sword [with] mouths.

5.he: רַ֭גְלֶיהָ יֹרְד֣וֹת מָ֑וֶת שְׁ֝א֗וֹל צְעָדֶ֥יהָ יִתְמֹֽכוּ׃

lines.text: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
Her feet are going down to death, Sheol do her steps take hold of.

5.he: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים פֶּן־תְּפַלֵּ֑ס נָע֥וּ מַ֝עְגְּלֹתֶ֗יהָ לֹ֣א תֵדָֽע׃

lines.text: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.
The path of life — lest thou ponder, Moved have her paths — thou knowest not.

5.he: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י וְאַל־תָּ֝ס֗וּרוּ מֵאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃

lines.text: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
And now, ye sons, hearken to me, And turn not from sayings of my mouth.

5.he: הַרְחֵ֣ק מֵעָלֶ֣יהָ דַרְכֶּ֑ךָ וְאַל־תִּ֝קְרַ֗ב אֶל־פֶּ֥תַח בֵּיתָֽהּ׃

lines.text: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
Keep far from off her thy way, And come not near unto the opening of her house,

5.he: פֶּן־תִּתֵּ֣ן לַאֲחֵרִ֣ים הוֹדֶ֑ךָ וּ֝שְׁנֹתֶ֗יךָ לְאַכְזָרִֽי׃

lines.text: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
Lest thou give to others thy honour, And thy years to the fierce,

5.he: פֶּֽן־יִשְׂבְּע֣וּ זָרִ֣ים כֹּחֶ֑ךָ וַ֝עֲצָבֶ֗יךָ בְּבֵ֣ית נָכְרִֽי׃

lines.text: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.
Lest strangers be filled [with] thy power, And thy labours in the house of a stranger,

5.he: וְנָהַמְתָּ֥ בְאַחֲרִיתֶ֑ךָ בִּכְל֥וֹת בְּ֝שָׂרְךָ֗ וּשְׁאֵרֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
And thou hast howled in thy latter end, In the consumption of thy flesh and thy food,

5.he: וְֽאָמַרְתָּ֗ אֵ֭יךְ שָׂנֵ֣אתִי מוּסָ֑ר וְ֝תוֹכַ֗חַת נָאַ֥ץ לִבִּֽי׃

lines.text: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
And hast said, 'How have I hated instruction, And reproof hath my heart despised,

5.he: וְֽלֹא־שָׁ֭מַעְתִּי בְּק֣וֹל מוֹרָ֑י וְ֝לִֽמְלַמְּדַ֗י לֹא־הִטִּ֥יתִי אָזְנִֽי׃

lines.text: neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
And I have not hearkened to the voice of my directors, And to my teachers have not inclined mine ear.

5.he: כִּ֭מְעַט הָיִ֣יתִי בְכָל־רָ֑ע בְּת֖וֹךְ קָהָ֣ל וְעֵדָֽה׃

lines.text: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”
As a little thing I have been all evil, In the midst of an assembly and a company.

5.he: שְׁתֵה־מַ֥יִם מִבּוֹרֶ֑ךָ וְ֝נֹזְלִ֗ים מִתּ֥וֹךְ בְּאֵרֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.
Drink waters out of thine own cistern, Even flowing ones out of thine own well.

5.he: יָפ֣וּצוּ מַעְיְנֹתֶ֣יךָ ח֑וּצָה בָּ֝רְחֹב֗וֹת פַּלְגֵי־מָֽיִם׃

lines.text: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?
Let thy fountains be scattered abroad, In broad places rivulets of waters.

5.he: יִֽהְיוּ־לְךָ֥ לְבַדֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֖ין לְזָרִ֣ים אִתָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.
Let them be to thee for thyself, And not to strangers with thee.

5.he: יְהִֽי־מְקוֹרְךָ֥ בָר֑וּךְ וּ֝שְׂמַ֗ח מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת נְעוּרֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
Let thy fountain be blessed, And rejoice because of the wife of thy youth,

5.he: אַיֶּ֥לֶת אֲהָבִ֗ים וְֽיַעֲלַ֫ת־חֵ֥ן דַּ֭דֶּיהָ יְרַוֻּ֣ךָ בְכָל־עֵ֑ת בְּ֝אַהֲבָתָ֗הּ תִּשְׁגֶּ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃

lines.text: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
A hind of loves, and a roe of grace! Let her loves satisfy thee at all times, In her love magnify thyself continually.

5.he: וְלָ֤מָּה תִשְׁגֶּ֣ה בְנִ֣י בְזָרָ֑ה וּ֝תְחַבֵּ֗ק חֵ֣ק נָכְרִיָּֽה׃

lines.text: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?
And why dost thou magnify thyself, My son, with a stranger? And embrace the bosom of a strange woman?

5.he: כִּ֤י נֹ֨כַח ׀ עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה דַּרְכֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְֽכָל־מַעְגְּלֹתָ֥יו מְפַלֵּֽס׃

lines.text: For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes. He examines all his paths.
For over-against the eyes of Jehovah are the ways of each, And all his paths He is pondering.

5.he: עַֽווֹנוֹתָ֗יו יִלְכְּדֻנ֥וֹ אֶת־הָרָשָׁ֑ע וּבְחַבְלֵ֥י חַ֝טָּאת֗וֹ יִתָּמֵֽךְ׃

lines.text: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
His own iniquities do capture the wicked, And with the ropes of his sin he is holden.

5.he: ה֗וּא יָ֭מוּת בְּאֵ֣ין מוּסָ֑ר וּבְרֹ֖ב אִוַּלְתּ֣וֹ יִשְׁגֶּֽה׃

lines.text: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
He dieth without instruction, And in the abundance of his folly magnifieth himself!

6.he: בְּ֭נִי אִם־עָרַ֣בְתָּ לְרֵעֶ֑ךָ תָּקַ֖עְתָּ לַזָּ֣ר כַּפֶּֽיךָ׃

lines.text: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,
My son! if thou hast been surety for thy friend, Hast stricken for a stranger thy hand,

6.he: נוֹקַ֥שְׁתָּ בְאִמְרֵי־פִ֑יךָ נִ֝לְכַּ֗דְתָּ בְּאִמְרֵי־פִֽיךָ׃

lines.text: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.
Hast been snared with sayings of thy mouth, Hast been captured with sayings of thy mouth,

6.he: עֲשֵׂ֨ה זֹ֥את אֵפ֪וֹא ׀ בְּנִ֡י וְֽהִנָּצֵ֗ל כִּ֘י בָ֤אתָ בְכַף־רֵעֶ֑ךָ לֵ֥ךְ הִ֝תְרַפֵּ֗ס וּרְהַ֥ב רֵעֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.
Do this now, my son, and be delivered, For thou hast come into the hand of thy friend. Go, trample on thyself, and strengthen thy friend,

6.he: אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן שֵׁנָ֣ה לְעֵינֶ֑יךָ וּ֝תְנוּמָ֗ה לְעַפְעַפֶּֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
Give not sleep to thine eyes, And slumber to thine eyelids,

6.he: הִ֭נָּצֵל כִּצְבִ֣י מִיָּ֑ד וּ֝כְצִפּ֗וֹר מִיַּ֥ד יָקֽוּשׁ׃

lines.text: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
Be delivered as a roe from the hand, And as a bird from the hand of a fowler.

6.he: לֵֽךְ־אֶל־נְמָלָ֥ה עָצֵ֑ל רְאֵ֖ה דְרָכֶ֣יהָ וַחֲכָֽם׃

lines.text: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
Go unto the ant, O slothful one, See her ways and be wise;

6.he: אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֵֽין־לָ֥הּ קָצִ֗ין שֹׁטֵ֥ר וּמֹשֵֽׁל׃

lines.text: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
Which hath not captain, overseer, and ruler,

6.he: תָּכִ֣ין בַּקַּ֣יִץ לַחְמָ֑הּ אָגְרָ֥ה בַ֝קָּצִ֗יר מַאֲכָלָֽהּ׃

lines.text: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
She doth prepare in summer her bread, She hath gathered in harvest her food.

6.he: עַד־מָתַ֖י עָצֵ֥ל ׀ תִּשְׁכָּ֑ב מָ֝תַ֗י תָּק֥וּם מִשְּׁנָתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
Till when, O slothful one, dost thou lie? When dost thou arise from thy sleep?

6.he: מְעַ֣ט שֵׁ֭נוֹת מְעַ֣ט תְּנוּמ֑וֹת מְעַ֓ט ׀ חִבֻּ֖ק יָדַ֣יִם לִשְׁכָּֽב׃

lines.text: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
A little sleep, a little slumber, A little clasping of the hands to rest,

6.he: וּבָֽא־כִמְהַלֵּ֥ךְ רֵאשֶׁ֑ךָ וּ֝מַחְסֹֽרְךָ֗ כְּאִ֣ישׁ מָגֵֽן׃

lines.text: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
And thy poverty hath come as a traveller, And thy want as an armed man.

6.he: אָדָ֣ם בְּ֭לִיַּעַל אִ֣ישׁ אָ֑וֶן ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ עִקְּשׁ֥וּת פֶּֽה׃

lines.text: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,
A man of worthlessness, a man of iniquity, Walking [with] perverseness of mouth,

6.he: קֹרֵ֣ץ בְּ֭עֵינָו מֹלֵ֣ל בְּרַגְלָ֑ו מֹ֝רֶ֗ה בְּאֶצְבְּעֹתָֽיו׃

lines.text: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,
Winking with his eyes, speaking with his feet, Directing with his fingers,

6.he: תַּֽהְפֻּכ֨וֹת ׀ בְּלִבּ֗וֹ חֹרֵ֣שׁ רָ֣ע בְּכָל־עֵ֑ת מדנים יְשַׁלֵּֽחַ׃

lines.text: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
Frowardness [is] in his heart, devising evil at all times, Contentions he sendeth forth.

6.he: עַל־כֵּ֗ן פִּ֭תְאֹם יָב֣וֹא אֵיד֑וֹ פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְאֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא׃

lines.text: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.
Therefore suddenly cometh his calamity, Instantly he is broken — and no healing.

6.he: שֶׁשׁ־הֵ֭נָּה שָׂנֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝שֶׁ֗בַע תועבות נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
These six hath Jehovah hated, Yea, seven [are] abominations to His soul.

6.he: עֵינַ֣יִם רָ֭מוֹת לְשׁ֣וֹן שָׁ֑קֶר וְ֝יָדַ֗יִם שֹׁפְכ֥וֹת דָּם־נָקִֽי׃

lines.text: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
Eyes high — tongues false — And hands shedding innocent blood —

6.he: לֵ֗ב חֹ֭רֵשׁ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָ֑וֶן רַגְלַ֥יִם מְ֝מַהֲר֗וֹת לָר֥וּץ לָֽרָעָה׃

lines.text: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
A heart devising thoughts of vanity — Feet hasting to run to evil —

6.he: יָפִ֣יחַ כְּ֭זָבִים עֵ֣ד שָׁ֑קֶר וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥חַ מְ֝דָנִ֗ים בֵּ֣ין אַחִֽים׃

lines.text: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
A false witness [who] doth breathe out lies — And one sending forth contentions between brethren.

6.he: נְצֹ֣ר בְּ֭נִי מִצְוַ֣ת אָבִ֑יךָ וְאַל־תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ תּוֹרַ֥ת אִמֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
Keep, my son, the command of thy father, And leave not the law of thy mother.

6.he: קָשְׁרֵ֣ם עַל־לִבְּךָ֣ תָמִ֑יד עָ֝נְדֵ֗ם עַל־גַּרְגְּרֹתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
Bind them on thy heart continually, Tie them on thy neck.

6.he: בְּהִתְהַלֶּכְךָ֨ ׀ תַּנְחֶ֬ה אֹתָ֗ךְ בְּֽ֭שָׁכְבְּךָ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר עָלֶ֑יךָ וַ֝הֲקִיצ֗וֹתָ הִ֣יא תְשִׂיחֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
In thy going up and down, it leadeth thee, In thy lying down, it watcheth over thee, And thou hast awaked — it talketh [with] thee.

6.he: כִּ֤י נֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה וְת֣וֹרָה א֑וֹר וְדֶ֥רֶךְ חַ֝יִּ֗ים תּוֹכְח֥וֹת מוּסָֽר׃

lines.text: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
For a lamp [is] the command, And the law a light, And a way of life [are] reproofs of instruction,

6.he: לִ֭שְׁמָרְךָ מֵאֵ֣שֶׁת רָ֑ע מֵֽ֝חֶלְקַ֗ת לָשׁ֥וֹן נָכְרִיָּֽה׃

lines.text: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
To preserve thee from an evil woman, From the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.

6.he: אַל־תַּחְמֹ֣ד יָ֭פְיָהּ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְאַל־תִּ֝קָּֽחֲךָ֗ בְּעַפְעַפֶּֽיהָ׃

lines.text: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
Desire not her beauty in thy heart, And let her not take thee with her eyelids.

6.he: כִּ֤י בְעַד־אִשָּׁ֥ה זוֹנָ֗ה עַֽד־כִּכַּ֫ר לָ֥חֶם וְאֵ֥שֶׁת אִ֑ישׁ נֶ֖פֶשׁ יְקָרָ֣ה תָצֽוּד׃

lines.text: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
For a harlot consumeth unto a cake of bread, And an adulteress the precious soul hunteth.

6.he: הֲיַחְתֶּ֤ה אִ֓ישׁ אֵ֬שׁ בְּחֵיק֑וֹ וּ֝בְגָדָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִשָּׂרַֽפְנָה׃

lines.text: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
Doth a man take fire into his bosom, And are his garments not burnt?

6.he: אִם־יְהַלֵּ֣ךְ אִ֭ישׁ עַל־הַגֶּחָלִ֑ים וְ֝רַגְלָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִכָּוֶֽינָה׃

lines.text: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
Doth a man walk on the hot coals, And are his feet not scorched?

6.he: כֵּ֗ן הַ֭בָּא אֶל־אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑הוּ לֹ֥א יִ֝נָּקֶ֗ה כָּֽל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּֽהּ׃

lines.text: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
So [is] he who hath gone in unto the wife of his neighbour, None who doth touch her is innocent.

6.he: לֹא־יָב֣וּזוּ לַ֭גַּנָּב כִּ֣י יִגְנ֑וֹב לְמַלֵּ֥א נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ כִּ֣י יִרְעָֽב׃

lines.text: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry;
They do not despise the thief, When he stealeth to fill his soul when he is hungry,

6.he: וְ֭נִמְצָא יְשַׁלֵּ֣ם שִׁבְעָתָ֑יִם אֶת־כָּל־ה֖וֹן בֵּית֣וֹ יִתֵּֽן׃

lines.text: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
And being found he repayeth sevenfold, All the substance of his house he giveth.

6.he: נֹאֵ֣ף אִשָּׁ֣ה חֲסַר־לֵ֑ב מַֽשְׁחִ֥ית נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ ה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂנָּה׃

lines.text: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
He who committeth adultery [with] a woman lacketh heart, He is destroying his soul who doth it.

6.he: נֶֽגַע־וְקָל֥וֹן יִמְצָ֑א וְ֝חֶרְפָּת֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִמָּחֶֽה׃

lines.text: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
A stroke and shame he doth find, And his reproach is not wiped away,

6.he: כִּֽי־קִנְאָ֥ה חֲמַת־גָּ֑בֶר וְלֹֽא־יַ֝חְמ֗וֹל בְּי֣וֹם נָקָֽם׃

lines.text: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.
For jealousy [is] the fury of a man, And he doth not spare in a day of vengeance.

6.he: לֹא־יִ֭שָּׂא פְּנֵ֣י כָל־כֹּ֑פֶר וְלֹֽא־יֹ֝אבֶ֗ה כִּ֣י תַרְבֶּה־שֹֽׁחַד׃

lines.text: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
He accepteth not the appearance of any atonement, Yea, he doth not consent, Though thou dost multiply bribes!

7.he: בְּ֭נִי שְׁמֹ֣ר אֲמָרָ֑י וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן אִתָּֽךְ׃

lines.text: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
My son! keep my sayings, And my commands lay up with thee.

7.he: שְׁמֹ֣ר מִצְוֺתַ֣י וֶחְיֵ֑ה וְ֝תוֹרָתִ֗י כְּאִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.
Keep my commands, and live, And my law as the pupil of thine eye.

7.he: קָשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל־אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל־ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃

lines.text: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
Bind them on thy fingers, Write them on the tablet of thy heart.

7.he: אֱמֹ֣ר לַֽ֭חָכְמָה אֲחֹ֣תִי אָ֑תְּ וּ֝מֹדָ֗ע לַבִּינָ֥ה תִקְרָֽא׃

lines.text: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
Say to wisdom, 'My sister Thou [art].' And cry to understanding, 'Kinswoman!'

7.he: לִ֭שְׁמָרְךָ מֵאִשָּׁ֣ה זָרָ֑ה מִ֝נָּכְרִיָּ֗ה אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה׃

lines.text: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
To preserve thee from a strange woman, From a stranger who hath made smooth her sayings.

7.he: כִּ֭י בְּחַלּ֣וֹן בֵּיתִ֑י בְּעַ֖ד אֶשְׁנַבִּ֣י נִשְׁקָֽפְתִּי׃

lines.text: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.
For, at a window of my house, Through my casement I have looked out,

7.he: וָאֵ֤רֶא בַפְּתָאיִ֗ם אָ֘בִ֤ינָה בַבָּנִ֗ים נַ֣עַר חֲסַר־לֵֽב׃

lines.text: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,
And I do see among the simple ones, I discern among the sons, A young man lacking understanding,

7.he: עֹבֵ֣ר בַּ֭שּׁוּק אֵ֣צֶל פִּנָּ֑הּ וְדֶ֖רֶךְ בֵּיתָ֣הּ יִצְעָֽד׃

lines.text: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,
Passing on in the street, near her corner, And the way [to] her house he doth step,

7.he: בְּנֶֽשֶׁף־בְּעֶ֥רֶב י֑וֹם בְּאִישׁ֥וֹן לַ֝֗יְלָה וַאֲפֵלָֽה׃

lines.text: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.
In the twilight — in the evening of day, In the darkness of night and blackness.

7.he: וְהִנֵּ֣ה אִ֭שָּׁה לִקְרָאת֑וֹ שִׁ֥ית ז֝וֹנָ֗ה וּנְצֻ֥רַת לֵֽב׃

lines.text: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
And, lo, a woman to meet him — (A harlot's dress, and watchful of heart,

7.he: הֹמִיָּ֣ה הִ֣יא וְסֹרָ֑רֶת בְּ֝בֵיתָ֗הּ לֹא־יִשְׁכְּנ֥וּ רַגְלֶֽיהָ׃

lines.text: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.
Noisy she [is], and stubborn, In her house her feet rest not.

7.he: פַּ֤עַם ׀ בַּח֗וּץ פַּ֥עַם בָּרְחֹב֑וֹת וְאֵ֖צֶל כָּל־פִּנָּ֣ה תֶאֱרֹֽב׃

lines.text: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.
Now in an out-place, now in broad places, And near every corner she lieth in wait) —

7.he: וְהֶחֱזִ֣יקָה בּ֭וֹ וְנָ֣שְׁקָה־לּ֑וֹ הֵעֵ֥זָה פָ֝נֶ֗יהָ וַתֹּ֣אמַר לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:
And she laid hold on him, and kissed him, She hath hardened her face, and saith to him,

7.he: זִבְחֵ֣י שְׁלָמִ֣ים עָלָ֑י הַ֝יּ֗וֹם שִׁלַּ֥מְתִּי נְדָרָֽי׃

lines.text: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.
'Sacrifices of peace-offerings [are] by me, To-day I have completed my vows.

7.he: עַל־כֵּ֭ן יָצָ֣אתִי לִקְרָאתֶ֑ךָ לְשַׁחֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וָאֶמְצָאֶֽךָּ׃

lines.text: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.
Therefore I have come forth to meet thee, To seek earnestly thy face, and I find thee.

7.he: מַ֭רְבַדִּים רָבַ֣דְתִּי עַרְשִׂ֑י חֲ֝טֻב֗וֹת אֵט֥וּן מִצְרָֽיִם׃

lines.text: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
[With] ornamental coverings I decked my couch, Carved works — cotton of Egypt.

7.he: נַ֥פְתִּי מִשְׁכָּבִ֑י מֹ֥ר אֲ֝הָלִ֗ים וְקִנָּמֽוֹן׃

lines.text: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
I sprinkled my bed — myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

7.he: לְכָ֤ה נִרְוֶ֣ה דֹ֭דִים עַד־הַבֹּ֑קֶר נִ֝תְעַלְּסָ֗ה בָּאֳהָבִֽים׃

lines.text: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.
Come, we are filled [with] loves till the morning, We delight ourselves in loves.

7.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין הָאִ֣ישׁ בְּבֵית֑וֹ הָ֝לַ֗ךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ מֵרָחֽוֹק׃

lines.text: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.
For the man is not in his house, He hath gone on a long journey.

7.he: צְֽרוֹר־הַ֭כֶּסֶף לָקַ֣ח בְּיָד֑וֹ לְי֥וֹם הַ֝כֵּ֗סֶא יָבֹ֥א בֵיתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”
A bag of money he hath taken in his hand, At the day of the new moon he cometh to his house.'

7.he: הִ֭טַּתּוּ בְּרֹ֣ב לִקְחָ֑הּ בְּחֵ֥לֶק שְׂ֝פָתֶ֗יהָ תַּדִּיחֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
She turneth him aside with the abundance of her speech, With the flattery of her lips she forceth him.

7.he: ה֤וֹלֵ֥ךְ אַחֲרֶ֗יהָ פִּ֫תְאֹ֥ם כְּ֭שׁוֹר אֶל־טֶ֣בַח יָב֑וֹא וּ֝כְעֶ֗כֶס אֶל־מוּסַ֥ר אֱוִֽיל׃

lines.text: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
He is going after her straightway, As an ox unto the slaughter he cometh, And as a fetter unto the chastisement of a fool,

7.he: עַ֤ד יְפַלַּ֪ח חֵ֡ץ כְּֽבֵד֗וֹ כְּמַהֵ֣ר צִפּ֣וֹר אֶל־פָּ֑ח וְלֹֽא־יָ֝דַ֗ע כִּֽי־בְנַפְשׁ֥וֹ הֽוּא׃

lines.text: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
Till an arrow doth split his liver, As a bird hath hastened unto a snare, And hath not known that it [is] for its life.

7.he: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לְאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃

lines.text: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
And now, ye sons, hearken to me, And give attention to sayings of my mouth.

7.he: אַל־יֵ֣שְׂטְ אֶל־דְּרָכֶ֣יהָ לִבֶּ֑ךָ אַל־תֵּ֝תַע בִּנְתִיבוֹתֶֽיהָ׃

lines.text: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,
Let not thy heart turn unto her ways, Do not wander in her paths,

7.he: כִּֽי־רַבִּ֣ים חֲלָלִ֣ים הִפִּ֑ילָה וַ֝עֲצֻמִ֗ים כָּל־הֲרֻגֶֽיהָ׃

lines.text: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.
For many [are] the wounded she caused to fall, And mighty [are] all her slain ones.

7.he: דַּרְכֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל בֵּיתָ֑הּ יֹ֝רְד֗וֹת אֶל־חַדְרֵי־מָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
The ways of Sheol — her house, Going down unto inner chambers of death!

8.he: הֲלֹֽא־חָכְמָ֥ה תִקְרָ֑א וּ֝תְבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ׃

lines.text: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
Doth not wisdom call? And understanding give forth her voice?

8.he: בְּרֹאשׁ־מְרוֹמִ֥ים עֲלֵי־דָ֑רֶךְ בֵּ֖ית נְתִיב֣וֹת נִצָּֽבָה׃

lines.text: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.
At the head of high places by the way, Between the paths she hath stood,

8.he: לְיַד־שְׁעָרִ֥ים לְפִי־קָ֑רֶת מְב֖וֹא פְתָחִ֣ים תָּרֹֽנָּה׃

lines.text: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:
At the side of the gates, at the mouth of the city, The entrance of the openings, she crieth aloud,

8.he: אֲלֵיכֶ֣ם אִישִׁ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וְ֝קוֹלִ֗י אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
'Unto you, O men, I call, And my voice [is] unto the sons of men.

8.he: הָבִ֣ינוּ פְתָאיִ֣ם עָרְמָ֑ה וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים הָבִ֥ינוּ לֵֽב׃

lines.text: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
Understand, ye simple ones, prudence, And ye fools, understand the heart,

8.he: שִׁ֭מְעוּ כִּֽי־נְגִידִ֣ים אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וּמִפְתַּ֥ח שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י מֵישָׁרִֽים׃

lines.text: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
Hearken, for noble things I speak, And the opening of my lips [is] uprightness.

8.he: כִּֽי־אֱ֭מֶת יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חִכִּ֑י וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת שְׂפָתַ֣י רֶֽשַׁע׃

lines.text: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
For truth doth my mouth utter, And an abomination to my lips [is] wickedness.

8.he: בְּצֶ֥דֶק כָּל־אִמְרֵי־פִ֑י אֵ֥ין בָּ֝הֶ֗ם נִפְתָּ֥ל וְעִקֵּֽשׁ׃

lines.text: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
In righteousness [are] all the sayings of my mouth, Nothing in them is froward and perverse.

8.he: כֻּלָּ֣ם נְ֭כֹחִים לַמֵּבִ֑ין וִֽ֝ישָׁרִ֗ים לְמֹ֣צְאֵי דָֽעַת׃

lines.text: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.
All of them [are] plain to the intelligent, And upright to those finding knowledge.

8.he: קְחֽוּ־מוּסָרִ֥י וְאַל־כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝דַ֗עַת מֵחָר֥וּץ נִבְחָֽר׃

lines.text: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
Receive my instruction, and not silver, And knowledge rather than choice gold.

8.he: כִּֽי־טוֹבָ֣ה חָ֭כְמָה מִפְּנִינִ֑ים וְכָל־חֲ֝פָצִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ־בָֽהּ׃

lines.text: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
For better [is] wisdom than rubies, Yea, all delights are not comparable with it.

8.he: אֲֽנִי־חָ֭כְמָה שָׁכַ֣נְתִּי עָרְמָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת מְזִמּ֣וֹת אֶמְצָֽא׃

lines.text: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
I, wisdom, have dwelt with prudence, And a knowledge of devices I find out.

8.he: יִ֥רְאַ֣ת יְהוָה֮ שְֽׂנֹ֫את רָ֥ע גֵּ֘אָ֤ה וְגָא֨וֹן ׀ וְדֶ֣רֶךְ רָ֭ע וּפִ֨י תַהְפֻּכ֬וֹת שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃

lines.text: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
The fear of Jehovah [is] to hate evil; Pride, and arrogance, and an evil way, And a froward mouth, I have hated.

8.he: לִֽי־עֵ֭צָה וְתוּשִׁיָּ֑ה אֲנִ֥י בִ֝ינָ֗ה לִ֣י גְבוּרָֽה׃

lines.text: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.
Mine [is] counsel and substance, I [am] understanding, I have might.

8.he: בִּ֭י מְלָכִ֣ים יִמְלֹ֑כוּ וְ֝רוֹזְנִ֗ים יְחֹ֣קְקוּ צֶֽדֶק׃

lines.text: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
By me kings reign, and princes decree righteousness,

8.he: בִּ֭י שָׂרִ֣ים יָשֹׂ֑רוּ וּ֝נְדִיבִ֗ים כָּל־שֹׁ֥פְטֵי צֶֽדֶק׃

lines.text: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
By me do chiefs rule, and nobles, All judges of the earth.

8.he: אֲ֭נִי אהביה אֵהָ֑ב וּ֝מְשַׁחֲרַ֗י יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי׃

lines.text: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
I love those loving me, And those seeking me earnestly do find me.

8.he: עֹֽשֶׁר־וְכָב֥וֹד אִתִּ֑י ה֥וֹן עָ֝תֵ֗ק וּצְדָקָֽה׃

lines.text: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
Wealth and honour [are] with me, Lasting substance and righteousness.

8.he: ט֣וֹב פִּ֭רְיִי מֵחָר֣וּץ וּמִפָּ֑ז וּ֝תְבוּאָתִ֗י מִכֶּ֥סֶף נִבְחָֽר׃

lines.text: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.
Better [is] my fruit than gold, even fine gold, And mine increase than choice silver.

8.he: בְּאֹֽרַח־צְדָקָ֥ה אֲהַלֵּ֑ך בְּ֝ת֗וֹךְ נְתִיב֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
In a path of righteousness I cause to walk, In midst of paths of judgment,

8.he: לְהַנְחִ֖יל אֹהֲבַ֥י ׀ יֵ֑שׁ וְאֹצְרֹ֖תֵיהֶ֣ם אֲמַלֵּֽא׃

lines.text: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.
To cause my lovers to inherit substance, Yea, their treasures I fill.

8.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה קָ֭נָנִי רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכּ֑וֹ קֶ֖דֶם מִפְעָלָ֣יו מֵאָֽז׃

lines.text: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
Jehovah possessed me — the beginning of His way, Before His works since then.

8.he: מֵ֭עוֹלָם נִסַּ֥כְתִּי מֵרֹ֗אשׁ מִקַּדְמֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
From the age I was anointed, from the first, From former states of the earth.

8.he: בְּאֵין־תְּהֹמ֥וֹת חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי בְּאֵ֥ין מַ֝עְיָנ֗וֹת נִכְבַּדֵּי־מָֽיִם׃

lines.text: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.
In there being no depths, I was brought forth, In there being no fountains heavy [with] waters,

8.he: בְּטֶ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים הָטְבָּ֑עוּ לִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתִּי׃

lines.text: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;
Before mountains were sunk, Before heights, I was brought forth.

8.he: עַד־לֹ֣א עָ֭שָׂה אֶ֣רֶץ וְחוּצ֑וֹת וְ֝רֹ֗אשׁ עָפְר֥וֹת תֵּבֵֽל׃

lines.text: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
While He had not made the earth, and out-places, And the top of the dusts of the world.

8.he: בַּהֲכִינ֣וֹ שָׁ֭מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑נִי בְּח֥וּקוֹ ח֝֗וּג עַל־פְּנֵ֥י תְהֽוֹם׃

lines.text: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,
In His preparing the heavens I [am] there, In His decreeing a circle on the face of the deep,

8.he: בְּאַמְּצ֣וֹ שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל בַּ֝עֲז֗וֹז עִינ֥וֹת תְּהוֹם׃

lines.text: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,
In His strengthening clouds above, In His making strong fountains of the deep,

8.he: בְּשׂ֘וּמ֤וֹ לַיָּ֨ם ׀ חֻקּ֗וֹ וּ֭מַיִם לֹ֣א יַֽעַבְרוּ־פִ֑יו בְּ֝חוּק֗וֹ מ֣וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
In His setting for the sea its limit, And the waters transgress not His command, In His decreeing the foundations of earth,

8.he: וָֽאֶהְיֶ֥ה אֶצְל֗וֹ אָ֫מ֥וֹן וָֽאֶהְיֶ֣ה שַׁ֭עֲשֻׁעִים י֤וֹם ׀ י֑וֹם מְשַׂחֶ֖קֶת לְפָנָ֣יו בְּכָל־עֵֽת׃

lines.text: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,
Then I am near Him, a workman, And I am a delight — day by day. Rejoicing before Him at all times,

8.he: מְ֭שַׂחֶקֶת בְּתֵבֵ֣ל אַרְצ֑וֹ וְ֝שַׁעֲשֻׁעַ֗י אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.
Rejoicing in the habitable part of His earth, And my delights [are] with the sons of men.

8.he: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁרֵ֗י דְּרָכַ֥י יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃

lines.text: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
And now, ye sons, hearken to me, Yea, happy are they who keep my ways.

8.he: שִׁמְע֖וּ מוּסָ֥ר וַחֲכָ֗מוּ וְאַל־תִּפְרָֽעוּ׃

lines.text: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.
Hear instruction, and be wise, and slight not.

8.he: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָם֮ שֹׁמֵ֪עַֽ֫ לִ֥י לִשְׁקֹ֣ד עַל־דַּ֭לְתֹתַי י֤וֹם ׀ י֑וֹם לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר מְזוּזֹ֥ת פְּתָחָֽי׃

lines.text: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
O the happiness of the man hearkening to me, To watch at my doors day by day, To watch at the door-posts of my entrance.

8.he: כִּ֣י מֹ֭צְאִי מצאי חַיִּ֑ים וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: For whoever finds me, finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.
For whoso is finding me, hath found life, And bringeth out good-will from Jehovah.

8.he: וְֽ֭חֹטְאִי חֹמֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ כָּל־מְ֝שַׂנְאַ֗י אָ֣הֲבוּ מָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
And whoso is missing me, is wronging his soul, All hating me have loved death!

9.he: חָ֭כְמוֹת בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑הּ חָצְבָ֖ה עַמּוּדֶ֣יהָ שִׁבְעָֽה׃

lines.text: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
Wisdom hath builded her house, She hath hewn out her pillars — seven.

9.he: טָבְחָ֣ה טִ֭בְחָהּ מָסְכָ֣ה יֵינָ֑הּ אַ֝֗ף עָֽרְכָ֥ה שֻׁלְחָנָֽהּ׃

lines.text: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
She hath slaughtered her slaughter, She hath mingled her wine, Yea, she hath arranged her table.

9.he: שָֽׁלְחָ֣ה נַעֲרֹתֶ֣יהָ תִקְרָ֑א עַל־גַּ֝פֵּ֗י מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת׃

lines.text: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:
She hath sent forth her damsels, She crieth on the tops of the high places of the city:

9.he: מִי־פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה חֲסַר־לֵ֝֗ב אָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
'Who [is] simple? let him turn aside hither.' Whoso lacketh heart: she hath said to him,

9.he: לְ֭כוּ לַחֲמ֣וּ בְֽלַחֲמִ֑י וּ֝שְׁת֗וּ בְּיַ֣יִן מָסָֽכְתִּי׃

lines.text: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!
'Come, eat of my bread, And drink of the wine I have mingled.

9.he: עִזְב֣וּ פְתָאיִ֣ם וִֽחְי֑וּ וְ֝אִשְׁר֗וּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ בִּינָֽה׃

lines.text: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
Forsake ye, the simple, and live, And be happy in the way of understanding.

9.he: יֹ֤סֵ֨ר ׀ לֵ֗ץ לֹקֵ֣חַֽ ל֣וֹ קָל֑וֹן וּמוֹכִ֖יחַ לְרָשָׁ֣ע מוּמֽוֹ׃

lines.text: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
The instructor of a scorner Is receiving for it — shame, And a reprover of the wicked — his blemish.

9.he: אַל־תּ֣וֹכַח לֵ֭ץ פֶּן־יִשְׂנָאֶ֑ךָּ הוֹכַ֥ח לְ֝חָכָ֗ם וְיֶאֱהָבֶֽךָּ׃

lines.text: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee, Give reproof to the wise, and he loveth thee.

9.he: תֵּ֣ן לְ֭חָכָם וְיֶחְכַּם־ע֑וֹד הוֹדַ֥ע לְ֝צַדִּ֗יק וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶֽקַח׃

lines.text: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
Give to the wise, and he is wiser still, Make known to the righteous, And he increaseth learning.

9.he: תְּחִלַּ֣ת חָ֭כְמָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת קְדֹשִׁ֣ים בִּינָֽה׃

lines.text: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
The commencement of wisdom [is] the fear of Jehovah, And a knowledge of the Holy Ones [is] understanding.

9.he: כִּי־בִ֭י יִרְבּ֣וּ יָמֶ֑יךָ וְיוֹסִ֥יפוּ לְּ֝ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים׃

lines.text: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
For by me do thy days multiply, And added to thee are years of life.
If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
If thou hast been wise, thou hast been wise for thyself, And thou hast scorned — thyself bearest [it].

9.he: אֵ֣שֶׁת כְּ֭סִילוּת הֹֽמִיָּ֑ה פְּ֝תַיּ֗וּת וּבַל־יָ֥דְעָה מָּֽה׃

lines.text: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.
A foolish woman [is] noisy, Simple, and hath not known what.

9.he: וְֽ֭יָשְׁבָה לְפֶ֣תַח בֵּיתָ֑הּ עַל־כִּ֝סֵּ֗א מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת׃

lines.text: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
And she hath sat at the opening of her house, On a throne — the high places of the city,
to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,
To call to those passing by the way, Who are going straight [on] their paths.

9.he: מִי־פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה וַחֲסַר־לֵ֝֗ב וְאָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” as for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
'Who [is] simple? let him turn aside hither.' And whoso lacketh heart — she said to him,
“Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
'Stolen waters are sweet, And hidden bread is pleasant.'

9.he: וְֽלֹא־יָ֭דַע כִּֽי־רְפָאִ֣ים שָׁ֑ם בְּעִמְקֵ֖י שְׁא֣וֹל קְרֻאֶֽיהָ׃

lines.text: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
And he hath not known that Rephaim [are] there, In deep places of Sheol her invited ones!

10.he: מִשְׁלֵ֗י שְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח־אָ֑ב וּבֵ֥ן כְּ֝סִ֗יל תּוּגַ֥ת אִמּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
Proverbs of Solomon. A wise son causeth a father to rejoice, And a foolish son [is] an affliction to his mother.

10.he: לֹא־י֭וֹעִילוּ אוֹצְר֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת׃

lines.text: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
Treasures of wickedness profit not, And righteousness delivereth from death.

10.he: לֹֽא־יַרְעִ֣יב יְ֭הוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְהַוַּ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים יֶהְדֹּֽף׃

lines.text: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
Jehovah causeth not the soul of the righteous to hunger, And the desire of the wicked He thrusteth away.

10.he: רָ֗אשׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה כַף־רְמִיָּ֑ה וְיַ֖ד חָרוּצִ֣ים תַּעֲשִֽׁיר׃

lines.text: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
Poor [is] he who is working — a slothful hand, And the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

10.he: אֹגֵ֣ר בַּ֭קַּיִץ בֵּ֣ן מַשְׂכִּ֑יל נִרְדָּ֥ם בַּ֝קָּצִ֗יר בֵּ֣ן מֵבִֽישׁ׃

lines.text: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
Whoso is gathering in summer [is] a wise son, Whoso is sleeping in harvest [is] a son causing shame.

10.he: בְּ֭רָכוֹת לְרֹ֣אשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס׃

lines.text: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
Blessings [are] for the head of the righteous, And the mouth of the wicked cover doth violence.

10.he: זֵ֣כֶר צַ֭דִּיק לִבְרָכָ֑ה וְשֵׁ֖ם רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִרְקָֽב׃

lines.text: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.
The remembrance of the righteous [is] for a blessing, And the name of the wicked doth rot.

10.he: חֲכַם־לֵ֭ב יִקַּ֣ח מִצְוֺ֑ת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט׃

lines.text: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
The wise in heart accepteth commands, And a talkative fool kicketh.

10.he: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בַּ֭תֹּם יֵ֣לֶךְ בֶּ֑טַח וּמְעַקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו יִוָּדֵֽעַ׃

lines.text: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
Whoso is walking in integrity walketh confidently, And whoso is perverting his ways is known.

10.he: קֹ֣רֵֽץ עַ֭יִן יִתֵּ֣ן עַצָּ֑בֶת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט׃

lines.text: One winking with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
Whoso is winking the eye giveth grief, And a talkative fool kicketh.

10.he: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים פִּ֣י צַדִּ֑יק וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס׃

lines.text: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
A fountain of life [is] the mouth of the righteous, And the mouth of the wicked cover doth violence.

10.he: שִׂ֭נְאָה תְּעוֹרֵ֣ר מְדָנִ֑ים וְעַ֥ל כָּל־פְּ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תְּכַסֶּ֥ה אַהֲבָֽה׃

lines.text: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
Hatred awaketh contentions, And over all transgressions love covereth.

10.he: בְּשִׂפְתֵ֣י נָ֭בוֹן תִּמָּצֵ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝שֵׁ֗בֶט לְגֵ֣ו חֲסַר־לֵֽב׃

lines.text: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
In the lips of the intelligent is wisdom found, And a rod [is] for the back of him who is lacking understanding.

10.he: חֲכָמִ֥ים יִצְפְּנוּ־דָ֑עַת וּפִֽי־אֱ֝וִיל מְחִתָּ֥ה קְרֹבָֽה׃

lines.text: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.
The wise lay up knowledge, and the mouth of a fool [is] near ruin.

10.he: ה֣וֹן עָ֭שִׁיר קִרְיַ֣ת עֻזּ֑וֹ מְחִתַּ֖ת דַּלִּ֣ים רֵישָֽׁם׃

lines.text: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
The wealth of the rich [is] his strong city, The ruin of the poor [is] their poverty.

10.he: פְּעֻלַּ֣ת צַדִּ֣יק לְחַיִּ֑ים תְּבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע לְחַטָּֽאת׃

lines.text: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
The wage of the righteous [is] for life, The increase of the wicked for sin.

10.he: אֹ֣רַח לְ֭חַיִּים שׁוֹמֵ֣ר מוּסָ֑ר וְעוֹזֵ֖ב תּוֹכַ֣חַת מַתְעֶֽה׃

lines.text: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.
A traveller to life [is] he who is keeping instruction, And whoso is forsaking rebuke is erring.

10.he: מְכַסֶּ֣ה שִׂ֭נְאָה שִׂפְתֵי־שָׁ֑קֶר וּמוֹצִ֥א דִ֝בָּ֗ה ה֣וּא כְסִֽיל׃

lines.text: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
Whoso is covering hatred with lying lips, And whoso is bringing out an evil report is a fool.

10.he: בְּרֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֶחְדַּל־פָּ֑שַׁע וְחֹשֵׂ֖ךְ שְׂפָתָ֣יו מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃

lines.text: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
In the abundance of words transgression ceaseth not, And whoso is restraining his lips [is] wise.

10.he: כֶּ֣סֶף נִ֭בְחָר לְשׁ֣וֹן צַדִּ֑יק לֵ֖ב רְשָׁעִ֣ים כִּמְעָֽט׃

lines.text: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
The tongue of the righteous [is] chosen silver, The heart of the wicked — as a little thing.

10.he: שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יִרְע֣וּ רַבִּ֑ים וֶֽ֝אֱוִילִ֗ים בַּחֲסַר־לֵ֥ב יָמֽוּתוּ׃

lines.text: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
The lips of the righteous delight many, And fools for lack of heart die.

10.he: בִּרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הִ֣יא תַעֲשִׁ֑יר וְלֹֽא־יוֹסִ֖ף עֶ֣צֶב עִמָּֽהּ׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
The blessing of Jehovah — it maketh rich, And He addeth no grief with it.

10.he: כִּשְׂח֣וֹק לִ֭כְסִיל עֲשׂ֣וֹת זִמָּ֑ה וְ֝חָכְמָ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה׃

lines.text: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.
To execute inventions [is] as play to a fool, And wisdom to a man of understanding.

10.he: מְגוֹרַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע הִ֣יא תְבוֹאֶ֑נּוּ וְתַאֲוַ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃

lines.text: What the wicked fear, will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
The feared thing of the wicked it meeteth him, And the desire of the righteous is given.

10.he: כַּעֲב֣וֹר ס֭וּפָה וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק יְס֣וֹד עוֹלָֽם׃

lines.text: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
As the passing by of a hurricane, So the wicked is not, And the righteous is a foundation age-during.

10.he: כַּחֹ֤מֶץ ׀ לַשִּׁנַּ֗יִם וְכֶעָשָׁ֥ן לָעֵינָ֑יִם כֵּ֥ן הֶ֝עָצֵ֗ל לְשֹׁלְחָֽיו׃

lines.text: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
As vinegar to the teeth, And as smoke to the eyes, So [is] the slothful to those sending him.

10.he: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה תּוֹסִ֣יף יָמִ֑ים וּשְׁנ֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּקְצֹֽרְנָה׃

lines.text: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
The fear of Jehovah addeth days, And the years of the wicked are shortened.

10.he: תּוֹחֶ֣לֶת צַדִּיקִ֣ים שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְתִקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃

lines.text: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
The hope of the righteous [is] joyful, And the expectation of the wicked perisheth.

10.he: מָע֣וֹז לַ֭תֹּם דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
The way of Jehovah [is] strength to the perfect, And ruin to workers of iniquity.

10.he: צַדִּ֣יק לְעוֹלָ֣ם בַּל־יִמּ֑וֹט וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִשְׁכְּנוּ־אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
The righteous to the age is not moved, And the wicked inhabit not the earth.

10.he: פִּֽי־צַ֭דִּיק יָנ֣וּב חָכְמָ֑ה וּלְשׁ֥וֹן תַּ֝הְפֻּכ֗וֹת תִּכָּרֵֽת׃

lines.text: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
The mouth of the righteous uttereth wisdom, And the tongue of frowardness is cut out.

10.he: שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יֵדְע֣וּן רָצ֑וֹן וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃

lines.text: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
The lips of the righteous know a pleasing thing, And the mouth of the wicked perverseness!

11.he: מֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭רְמָה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶ֖בֶן שְׁלֵמָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃

lines.text: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
Balances of deceit [are] an abomination to Jehovah, And a perfect weight [is] His delight.

11.he: בָּֽא־זָ֭דוֹן וַיָּבֹ֣א קָל֑וֹן וְֽאֶת־צְנוּעִ֥ים חָכְמָֽה׃

lines.text: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
Pride hath come, and shame cometh, And with the lowly [is] wisdom.

11.he: תֻּמַּ֣ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים תַּנְחֵ֑ם וְסֶ֖לֶף בּוֹגְדִ֣ים ושדם׃

lines.text: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
The integrity of the upright leadeth them, And the perverseness of the treacherous destroyeth them.

11.he: לֹא־יוֹעִ֣יל ה֭וֹן בְּי֣וֹם עֶבְרָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת׃

lines.text: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
Wealth profiteth not in a day of wrath, And righteousness delivereth from death.

11.he: צִדְקַ֣ת תָּ֭מִים תְּיַשֵּׁ֣ר דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְרִשְׁעָת֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל רָשָֽׁע׃

lines.text: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
The righteousness of the perfect maketh right his way, And by his wickedness doth the wicked fall.

11.he: צִדְקַ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תַּצִּילֵ֑ם וּ֝בְהַוַּ֗ת בֹּגְדִ֥ים יִלָּכֵֽדוּ׃

lines.text: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
The righteousness of the upright delivereth them, And in mischief the treacherous are captured.

11.he: בְּמ֤וֹת אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע תֹּאבַ֣ד תִּקְוָ֑ה וְתוֹחֶ֖לֶת אוֹנִ֣ים אָבָֽדָה׃

lines.text: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
In the death of a wicked man, hope perisheth, And the expectation of the iniquitous hath been lost.

11.he: צַ֭דִּיק מִצָּרָ֣ה נֶחֱלָ֑ץ וַיָּבֹ֖א רָשָׁ֣ע תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

lines.text: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.
The righteous from distress is drawn out, And the wicked goeth in instead of him.

11.he: בְּפֶ֗ה חָ֭נֵף יַשְׁחִ֣ת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וּ֝בְדַ֗עַת צַדִּיקִ֥ים יֵחָלֵֽצוּ׃

lines.text: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
With the mouth a hypocrite corrupteth his friend, And by knowledge the righteous are drawn out.

11.he: בְּט֣וּב צַ֭דִּיקִים תַּעֲלֹ֣ץ קִרְיָ֑ה וּבַאֲבֹ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים רִנָּֽה׃

lines.text: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
In the good of the righteous a city exulteth, And in the destruction of the wicked [is] singing.

11.he: בְּבִרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תָּר֣וּם קָ֑רֶת וּבְפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תֵּהָרֵֽס׃

lines.text: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
By the blessing of the upright is a city exalted, And by the mouth of the wicked thrown down.

11.he: בָּז־לְרֵעֵ֥הוּ חֲסַר־לֵ֑ב וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנ֣וֹת יַחֲרִֽישׁ׃

lines.text: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
Whoso is despising his neighbour lacketh heart, And a man of understanding keepeth silence.

11.he: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָ֭כִיל מְגַלֶּה־סּ֑וֹד וְנֶאֱמַן־ר֝֗וּחַ מְכַסֶּ֥ה דָבָֽר׃

lines.text: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
A busybody is revealing secret counsel, And the faithful of spirit is covering the matter.

11.he: בְּאֵ֣ין תַּ֭חְבֻּלוֹת יִפָּל־עָ֑ם וּ֝תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּרֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ׃

lines.text: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
Without counsels do a people fall, And deliverance [is] in a multitude of counsellors.

11.he: רַע־יֵ֭רוֹעַ כִּי־עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וְשֹׂנֵ֖א תֹקְעִ֣ים בּוֹטֵֽחַ׃

lines.text: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
Evil [one] suffereth when he hath been surety [for] a stranger, And whoso is hating suretyship is confident.

11.he: אֵֽשֶׁת־חֵ֭ן תִּתְמֹ֣ךְ כָּב֑וֹד וְ֝עָרִיצִ֗ים יִתְמְכוּ־עֹֽשֶׁר׃

lines.text: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
A gracious woman retaineth honour, And terrible [men] retain riches.

11.he: גֹּמֵ֣ל נַ֭פְשׁוֹ אִ֣ישׁ חָ֑סֶד וְעֹכֵ֥ר שְׁ֝אֵר֗וֹ אַכְזָרִֽי׃

lines.text: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
A kind man is rewarding his own soul, And the fierce is troubling his own flesh.

11.he: רָשָׁ֗ע עֹשֶׂ֥ה פְעֻלַּת־שָׁ֑קֶר וְזֹרֵ֥עַ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה שֶׂ֣כֶר אֱמֶֽת׃

lines.text: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
The wicked is getting a lying wage, And whoso is sowing righteousness — a true reward.

11.he: כֵּן־צְדָקָ֥ה לְחַיִּ֑ים וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רָעָ֣ה לְמוֹתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
Rightly [is] righteousness for life, And whoso is pursuing evil — for his own death.

11.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה עִקְּשֵׁי־לֵ֑ב וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ תְּמִ֣ימֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃

lines.text: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
An abomination to Jehovah [are] the perverse of heart, And the perfect of the way [are] His delight.

11.he: יָ֣ד לְ֭יָד לֹא־יִנָּ֣קֶה רָּ֑ע וְזֶ֖רַע צַדִּיקִ֣ים נִמְלָֽט׃

lines.text: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
Hand to hand, the wicked is not acquitted, And the seed of the righteous hath escaped.

11.he: נֶ֣זֶם זָ֭הָב בְּאַ֣ף חֲזִ֑יר אִשָּׁ֥ה יָ֝פָ֗ה וְסָ֣רַת טָֽעַם׃

lines.text: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
A ring of gold in the nose of a sow — A fair woman and stubborn of behaviour.

11.he: תַּאֲוַ֣ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים אַךְ־ט֑וֹב תִּקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֶבְרָֽה׃

lines.text: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
The desire of the righteous [is] only good, The hope of the wicked [is] transgression.

11.he: יֵ֣שׁ מְ֭פַזֵּר וְנוֹסָ֥ף ע֑וֹד וְחוֹשֵׂ֥ךְ מִ֝יֹּ֗שֶׁר אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃

lines.text: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.
There is who is scattering, and yet is increased, And who is keeping back from uprightness, only to want.

11.he: נֶֽפֶשׁ־בְּרָכָ֥ה תְדֻשָּׁ֑ן וּ֝מַרְוֶ֗ה גַּם־ה֥וּא יוֹרֶֽא׃

lines.text: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
A liberal soul is made fat, And whoso is watering, he also is watered.

11.he: מֹ֣נֵֽעַ בָּ֭ר יִקְּבֻ֣הוּ לְא֑וֹם וּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ מַשְׁבִּֽיר׃

lines.text: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
Whoso is withholding corn, the people execrate him, And a blessing [is] for the head of him who is selling.

11.he: שֹׁ֣חֵֽר ט֭וֹב יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ רָצ֑וֹן וְדֹרֵ֖שׁ רָעָ֣ה תְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.
Whoso is earnestly seeking good Seeketh a pleasing thing, And whoso is seeking evil — it meeteth him.

11.he: בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭עָשְׁרוֹ ה֣וּא יִפֹּ֑ל וְ֝כֶעָלֶ֗ה צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִפְרָֽחוּ׃

lines.text: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
Whoso is confident in his wealth he falleth, And as a leaf, the righteous flourish.

11.he: עוֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ יִנְחַל־ר֑וּחַ וְעֶ֥בֶד אֱ֝וִ֗יל לַחֲכַם־לֵֽב׃

lines.text: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
Whoso is troubling his own house inheriteth wind, And a servant [is] the fool to the wise of heart.

11.he: פְּֽרִי־צַ֭דִּיק עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְלֹקֵ֖חַ נְפָשׂ֣וֹת חָכָֽם׃

lines.text: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
The fruit of the righteous [is] a tree of life, And whoso is taking souls [is] wise.

11.he: הֵ֣ן צַ֭דִּיק בָּאָ֣רֶץ יְשֻׁלָּ֑ם אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־רָשָׁ֥ע וְחוֹטֵֽא׃
