lines.text: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
Lo, the righteous in the earth is recompensed, Surely also the wicked and the sinner!

12.he: אֹהֵ֣ב מ֭וּסָר אֹ֣הֵֽב דָּ֑עַת וְשֹׂנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת בָּֽעַר׃

lines.text: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
Whoso is loving instruction, is loving knowledge, And whoso is hating reproof [is] brutish.

12.he: ט֗וֹב יָפִ֣יק רָ֭צוֹן מֵיְהוָ֑ה וְאִ֖ישׁ מְזִמּ֣וֹת יַרְשִֽׁיעַ׃

lines.text: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.
The good bringeth forth favour from Jehovah, And the man of wicked devices He condemneth.

12.he: לֹא־יִכּ֣וֹן אָדָ֣ם בְּרֶ֑שַׁע וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים בַּל־יִמּֽוֹט׃

lines.text: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
A man is not established by wickedness, And the root of the righteous is not moved.

12.he: אֵֽשֶׁת־חַ֭יִל עֲטֶ֣רֶת בַּעְלָ֑הּ וּכְרָקָ֖ב בְּעַצְמוֹתָ֣יו מְבִישָֽׁה׃

lines.text: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
A virtuous woman [is] a crown to her husband, And as rottenness in his bones [is] one causing shame.

12.he: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים מִשְׁפָּ֑ט תַּחְבֻּל֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃

lines.text: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
The thoughts of the righteous [are] justice, The counsels of the wicked — deceit.

12.he: דִּבְרֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֱרָב־דָּ֑ם וּפִ֥י יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם׃

lines.text: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
The words of the wicked [are]: 'Lay wait for blood,' And the mouth of the upright delivereth them.

12.he: הָפ֣וֹךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים וְאֵינָ֑ם וּבֵ֖ית צַדִּיקִ֣ים יַעֲמֹֽד׃

lines.text: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
Overthrow the wicked, and they are not, And the house of the righteous standeth.

12.he: לְֽפִי־שִׂ֭כְלוֹ יְהֻלַּל־אִ֑ישׁ וְנַעֲוֵה־לֵ֝֗ב יִהְיֶ֥ה לָבֽוּז׃

lines.text: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
According to his wisdom is a man praised, And the perverted of heart becometh despised.

12.he: ט֣וֹב נִ֭קְלֶה וְעֶ֣בֶד ל֑וֹ מִ֝מְּתַכַּבֵּ֗ד וַחֲסַר־לָֽחֶם׃

lines.text: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself, and lacks bread.
Better [is] the lightly esteemed who hath a servant, Than the self-honoured who lacketh bread.

12.he: יוֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק נֶ֣פֶשׁ בְּהֶמְתּ֑וֹ וְֽרַחֲמֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַכְזָרִֽי׃

lines.text: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
The righteous knoweth the life of his beast, And the mercies of the wicked [are] cruel.

12.he: עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־לָ֑חֶם וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רֵיקִ֣ים חֲסַר־לֵֽב׃

lines.text: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
Whoso is tilling the ground is satisfied [with] bread, And whoso is pursuing vanities is lacking heart,

12.he: חָמַ֣ד רָ֭שָׁע מְצ֣וֹד רָעִ֑ים וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃

lines.text: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
The wicked hath desired the net of evil doers, And the root of the righteous giveth.

12.he: בְּפֶ֣שַׁע שְׂ֭פָתַיִם מוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָ֑ע וַיֵּצֵ֖א מִצָּרָ֣ה צַדִּֽיק׃

lines.text: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
In transgression of the lips [is] the snare of the wicked, And the righteous goeth out from distress.

12.he: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי־אִ֭ישׁ יִשְׂבַּע־ט֑וֹב וּגְמ֥וּל יְדֵי־אָ֝דָ֗ם ישוב לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
From the fruit of the mouth [is] one satisfied [with] good, And the deed of man's hands returneth to him.

12.he: דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֱ֭וִיל יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖עַ לְעֵצָ֣ה חָכָֽם׃

lines.text: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
The way of a fool [is] right in his own eyes, And whoso is hearkening to counsel [is] wise.

12.he: אֱוִ֗יל בַּ֭יּוֹם יִוָּדַ֣ע כַּעְס֑וֹ וְכֹסֶ֖ה קָל֣וֹן עָרֽוּם׃

lines.text: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
The fool — in a day is his anger known, And the prudent is covering shame.

12.he: יָפִ֣יחַ אֱ֭מוּנָה יַגִּ֣יד צֶ֑דֶק וְעֵ֖ד שְׁקָרִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃

lines.text: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
Whoso uttereth faithfulness declareth righteousness, And a false witness — deceit.

12.he: יֵ֣שׁ בּ֭וֹטֶה כְּמַדְקְר֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב וּלְשׁ֖וֹן חֲכָמִ֣ים מַרְפֵּֽא׃

lines.text: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
A rash speaker is like piercings of a sword, And the tongue of the wise is healing.

12.he: שְֽׂפַת־אֱ֭מֶת תִּכּ֣וֹן לָעַ֑ד וְעַד־אַ֝רְגִּ֗יעָה לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃

lines.text: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
The lip of truth is established for ever, And for a moment — a tongue of falsehood.

12.he: מִ֭רְמָה בְּלֶב־חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וּֽלְיֹעֲצֵ֖י שָׁל֣וֹם שִׂמְחָֽה׃

lines.text: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
Deceit [is] in the heart of those devising evil, And to those counselling peace [is] joy.

12.he: לֹא־יְאֻנֶּ֣ה לַצַּדִּ֣יק כָּל־אָ֑וֶן וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים מָ֣לְאוּ רָֽע׃

lines.text: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
No iniquity is desired by the righteous, And the wicked have been full of evil.

12.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה שִׂפְתֵי־שָׁ֑קֶר וְעֹשֵׂ֖י אֱמוּנָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.
An abomination to Jehovah [are] lying lips, And stedfast doers [are] his delight.

12.he: אָדָ֣ם עָ֭רוּם כֹּ֣סֶה דָּ֑עַת וְלֵ֥ב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים יִקְרָ֥א אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

lines.text: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
A prudent man is concealing knowledge, And the heart of fools proclaimeth folly.

12.he: יַד־חָרוּצִ֥ים תִּמְשׁ֑וֹל ו֝רְמִיָּ֗ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָמַֽס׃

lines.text: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
The hand of the diligent ruleth, And slothfulness becometh tributary.

12.he: דְּאָגָ֣ה בְלֶב־אִ֣ישׁ יַשְׁחֶ֑נָּה וְדָבָ֖ר ט֣וֹב יְשַׂמְּחֶֽנָּה׃

lines.text: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
Sorrow in the heart of a man boweth down, And a good word maketh him glad.

12.he: יָתֵ֣ר מֵרֵעֵ֣הוּ צַדִּ֑יק וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּתְעֵֽם׃

lines.text: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
The righteous searcheth his companion, And the way of the wicked causeth them to err.

12.he: לֹא־יַחֲרֹ֣ךְ רְמִיָּ֣ה צֵיד֑וֹ וְהוֹן־אָדָ֖ם יָקָ֣ר חָרֽוּץ׃

lines.text: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
The slothful roasteth not his hunting, And the wealth of a diligent man is precious.

12.he: בְּאֹֽרַח־צְדָקָ֥ה חַיִּ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ נְתִיבָ֣ה אַל־מָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
In the path of righteousness [is] life, And in the way of [that] path [is] no death!

13.he: בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝לֵ֗ץ לֹא־שָׁמַ֥ע גְּעָרָֽה׃

lines.text: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
A wise son — the instruction of a father, And a scorner — he hath not heard rebuke.

13.he: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי־אִ֭ישׁ יֹ֣אכַל ט֑וֹב וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ בֹּגְדִ֣ים חָמָֽס׃

lines.text: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.
From the fruit of the mouth a man eateth good, And the soul of the treacherous — violence.

13.he: נֹצֵ֣ר פִּ֭יו שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑וֹ פֹּשֵׂ֥ק שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו מְחִתָּה־לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
Whoso is keeping his mouth, is keeping his soul, Whoso is opening wide his lips — ruin to him!

13.he: מִתְאַוָּ֣ה וָ֭אַיִן נַפְשׁ֣וֹ עָצֵ֑ל וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ חָרֻצִ֣ים תְּדֻשָּֽׁן׃

lines.text: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
The soul of the slothful is desiring, and hath not. And the soul of the diligent is made fat.

13.he: דְּבַר־שֶׁ֭קֶר יִשְׂנָ֣א צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝רָשָׁ֗ע יַבְאִ֥ישׁ וְיַחְפִּֽיר׃

lines.text: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
A false word the righteous hateth, And the wicked causeth abhorrence, and is confounded.

13.he: צְ֭דָקָה תִּצֹּ֣ר תָּם־דָּ֑רֶךְ וְ֝רִשְׁעָ֗ה תְּסַלֵּ֥ף חַטָּֽאת׃

lines.text: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
Righteousness keepeth him who is perfect in the way, And wickedness overthroweth a sin offering.

13.he: יֵ֣שׁ מִ֭תְעַשֵּׁר וְאֵ֣ין כֹּ֑ל מִ֝תְרוֹשֵׁ֗שׁ וְה֣וֹן רָֽב׃

lines.text: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
There is who is making himself rich, and hath nothing, Who is making himself poor, and wealth [is] abundant.

13.he: כֹּ֣פֶר נֶֽפֶשׁ־אִ֣ישׁ עָשְׁר֑וֹ וְ֝רָ֗שׁ לֹא־שָׁמַ֥ע גְּעָרָֽה׃

lines.text: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
The ransom of a man's life [are] his riches, And the poor hath not heard rebuke.

13.he: אוֹר־צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִשְׂמָ֑ח וְנֵ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָֽךְ׃

lines.text: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
The light of the righteous rejoiceth, And the lamp of the wicked is extinguished.

13.he: רַק־בְּ֭זָדוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן מַצָּ֑ה וְאֶת־נ֖וֹעָצִ֣ים חָכְמָֽה׃

lines.text: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.
A vain man through pride causeth debate, And with the counselled [is] wisdom.

13.he: ה֭וֹן מֵהֶ֣בֶל יִמְעָ֑ט וְקֹבֵ֖ץ עַל־יָ֣ד יַרְבֶּֽה׃

lines.text: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.
Wealth from vanity becometh little, And whoso is gathering by the hand becometh great.

13.he: תּוֹחֶ֣לֶת מְ֭מֻשָּׁכָה מַחֲלָה־לֵ֑ב וְעֵ֥ץ חַ֝יִּ֗ים תַּאֲוָ֥ה בָאָֽה׃

lines.text: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
Hope prolonged is making the heart sick, And a tree of life [is] the coming desire.

13.he: בָּ֣ז לְ֭דָבָר יֵחָ֣בֶל ל֑וֹ וִירֵ֥א מִ֝צְוָ֗ה ה֣וּא יְשֻׁלָּֽם׃

lines.text: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
Whoso is despising the Word is destroyed for it, And whoso is fearing the Command is repayed.

13.he: תּוֹרַ֣ת חָ֭כָם מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝ס֗וּר מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
The law of the wise [is] a fountain of life, To turn aside from snares of death.

13.he: שֵֽׂכֶל־ט֭וֹב יִתֶּן־חֵ֑ן וְדֶ֖רֶךְ בֹּגְדִ֣ים אֵיתָֽן׃

lines.text: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
Good understanding giveth grace, And the way of the treacherous [is] hard.

13.he: כָּל־עָ֭רוּם יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה בְדָ֑עַת וּ֝כְסִ֗יל יִפְרֹ֥שׂ אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

lines.text: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
Every prudent one dealeth with knowledge, And a fool spreadeth out folly.

13.he: מַלְאָ֣ךְ רָ֭שָׁע יִפֹּ֣ל בְּרָ֑ע וְצִ֖יר אֱמוּנִ֣ים מַרְפֵּֽא׃

lines.text: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
A wicked messenger falleth into evil, And a faithful ambassador is healing.

13.he: רֵ֣ישׁ וְ֭קָלוֹן פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר וְשׁוֹמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יְכֻבָּֽד׃

lines.text: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
Whoso is refusing instruction — poverty and shame, And whoso is observing reproof is honoured.

13.he: תַּאֲוָ֣ה נִ֭הְיָה תֶּעֱרַ֣ב לְנָ֑פֶשׁ וְתוֹעֲבַ֥ת כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים ס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃

lines.text: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
A desire accomplished is sweet to the soul, And an abomination to fools [is]: Turn from evil.

13.he: הלוך אֶת־חֲכָמִ֣ים וחכם וְרֹעֶ֖ה כְסִילִ֣ים יֵרֽוֹעַ׃

lines.text: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
Whoso is walking with wise men is wise, And a companion of fools suffereth evil.

13.he: חַ֭טָּאִים תְּרַדֵּ֣ף רָעָ֑ה וְאֶת־צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יְשַׁלֶּם־טֽוֹב׃

lines.text: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
Evil pursueth sinners, And good recompenseth the righteous.

13.he: ט֗וֹב יַנְחִ֥יל בְּנֵֽי־בָנִ֑ים וְצָפ֥וּן לַ֝צַּדִּ֗יק חֵ֣יל חוֹטֵֽא׃

lines.text: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
A good man causeth sons' sons to inherit, And laid up for the righteous [is] the sinner's wealth.

13.he: רָב־אֹ֭כֶל נִ֣יר רָאשִׁ֑ים וְיֵ֥שׁ נִ֝סְפֶּ֗ה בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
Abundance of food — the tillage of the poor, And substance is consumed without judgment.

13.he: חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ שִׁ֭בְטוֹ שׂוֹנֵ֣א בְנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֹהֲב֗וֹ שִֽׁחֲר֥וֹ מוּסָֽר׃

lines.text: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
Whoso is sparing his rod is hating his son, And whoso is loving him hath hastened him chastisement.

13.he: צַדִּ֗יק אֹ֭כֵל לְשֹׂ֣בַע נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּבֶ֖טֶן רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֶּחְסָֽר׃

lines.text: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
The righteous is eating to the satiety of his soul, And the belly of the wicked lacketh!

14.he: חַכְמ֣וֹת נָ֭שִׁים בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑הּ וְ֝אִוֶּ֗לֶת בְּיָדֶ֥יהָ תֶהֶרְסֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
Every wise woman hath builded her house, And the foolish with her hands breaketh it down.

14.he: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּ֭יָשְׁרוֹ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּנְל֖וֹז דְּרָכָ֣יו בּוֹזֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
Whoso is walking in his uprightness is fearing Jehovah, And the perverted [in] his ways is despising Him.

14.he: בְּֽפִי־אֱ֭וִיל חֹ֣טֶר גַּאֲוָ֑ה וְשִׂפְתֵ֥י חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים תִּשְׁמוּרֵֽם׃

lines.text: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
In the mouth of a fool [is] a rod of pride, And the lips of the wise preserve them.

14.he: בְּאֵ֣ין אֲ֭לָפִים אֵב֣וּס בָּ֑ר וְרָב־תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּכֹ֣חַ שֽׁוֹר׃

lines.text: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
Without oxen a stall [is] clean, And great [is] the increase by the power of the ox.

14.he: עֵ֣ד אֱ֭מוּנִים לֹ֣א יְכַזֵּ֑ב וְיָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים עֵ֣ד שָֽׁקֶר׃

lines.text: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
A faithful witness lieth not, And a false witness breatheth out lies.

14.he: בִּקֶּשׁ־לֵ֣ץ חָכְמָ֣ה וָאָ֑יִן וְדַ֖עַת לְנָב֣וֹן נָקָֽל׃

lines.text: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
A scorner hath sought wisdom, and it is not, And knowledge to the intelligent [is] easy.

14.he: לֵ֣ךְ מִ֭נֶּגֶד לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּסִ֑יל וּבַל־יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ שִׂפְתֵי־דָֽעַת׃

lines.text: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.
Go from before a foolish man, Or thou hast not known the lips of knowledge.

14.he: חָכְמַ֣ת עָ֭רוּם הָבִ֣ין דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְאִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃

lines.text: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
The wisdom of the prudent [is] to understand his way, And the folly of fools [is] deceit.

14.he: אֱ֭וִלִים יָלִ֣יץ אָשָׁ֑ם וּבֵ֖ין יְשָׁרִ֣ים רָצֽוֹן׃

lines.text: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
Fools mock at a guilt-offering, And among the upright — a pleasing thing.

14.he: לֵ֗ב י֭וֹדֵעַ מָרַּ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּ֝בְשִׂמְחָת֗וֹ לֹא־יִתְעָ֥רַב זָֽר׃

lines.text: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
The heart knoweth its own bitterness, And with its joy a stranger doth not intermeddle.

14.he: בֵּ֣ית רְ֭שָׁעִים יִשָּׁמֵ֑ד וְאֹ֖הֶל יְשָׁרִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיחַ׃

lines.text: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
The house of the wicked is destroyed, And the tent of the upright flourisheth.

14.he: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי־מָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
There is a way — right before a man, And its latter end [are] ways of death.

14.he: גַּם־בִּשְׂח֥וֹק יִכְאַב־לֵ֑ב וְאַחֲרִיתָ֖הּ שִׂמְחָ֣ה תוּגָֽה׃

lines.text: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
Even in laughter is the heart pained, And the latter end of joy [is] affliction.

14.he: מִדְּרָכָ֣יו יִ֭שְׂבַּע ס֣וּג לֵ֑ב וּ֝מֵעָלָ֗יו אִ֣ישׁ טֽוֹב׃

lines.text: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
From his ways is the backslider in heart filled, And a good man — from his fruits.

14.he: פֶּ֭תִי יַאֲמִ֣ין לְכָל־דָּבָ֑ר וְ֝עָר֗וּם יָבִ֥ין לַאֲשֻׁרֽוֹ׃

lines.text: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
The simple giveth credence to everything, And the prudent attendeth to his step.

14.he: חָכָ֣ם יָ֭רֵא וְסָ֣ר מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל מִתְעַבֵּ֥ר וּבוֹטֵֽחַ׃

lines.text: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
The wise is fearing and turning from evil, And a fool is transgressing and is confident.

14.he: קְֽצַר־אַ֭פַּיִם יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אִוֶּ֑לֶת וְאִ֥ישׁ מְ֝זִמּ֗וֹת יִשָּׂנֵֽא׃

lines.text: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
Whoso is short of temper doth folly, And a man of wicked devices is hated.

14.he: נָחֲל֣וּ פְתָאיִ֣ם אִוֶּ֑לֶת וַֽ֝עֲרוּמִ֗ים יַכְתִּ֥רוּ דָֽעַת׃

lines.text: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
The simple have inherited folly, And the prudent are crowned [with] knowledge.

14.he: שַׁח֣וּ רָ֭עִים לִפְנֵ֣י טוֹבִ֑ים וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים עַֽל־שַׁעֲרֵ֥י צַדִּֽיק׃

lines.text: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
The evil have bowed down before the good, And the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

14.he: גַּם־לְ֭רֵעֵהוּ יִשָּׂ֣נֵא רָ֑שׁ וְאֹהֲבֵ֖י עָשִׁ֣יר רַבִּֽים׃

lines.text: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
Even of his neighbour is the poor hated, And those loving the rich [are] many.

14.he: בָּז־לְרֵעֵ֥הוּ חוֹטֵ֑א וּמְחוֹנֵ֖ן עניים אַשְׁרָֽיו׃

lines.text: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.
Whoso is despising his neighbour sinneth, Whoso is favouring the humble, O his happiness.

14.he: הֲֽלוֹא־יִ֭תְעוּ חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וְחֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת חֹ֣רְשֵׁי טֽוֹב׃

lines.text: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
Do not they err who are devising evil? And kindness and truth [are] to those devising good,

14.he: בְּכָל־עֶ֭צֶב יִהְיֶ֣ה מוֹתָ֑ר וּדְבַר־שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃

lines.text: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
In all labour there is advantage, And a thing of the lips [is] only to want.

14.he: עֲטֶ֣רֶת חֲכָמִ֣ים עָשְׁרָ֑ם אִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

lines.text: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.
The crown of the wise is their wealth, The folly of fools [is] folly.

14.he: מַצִּ֣יל נְ֭פָשׁוֹת עֵ֣ד אֱמֶ֑ת וְיָפִ֖חַ כְּזָבִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃

lines.text: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
A true witness is delivering souls, And a deceitful one breatheth out lies.

14.he: בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מִבְטַח־עֹ֑ז וּ֝לְבָנָ֗יו יִהְיֶ֥ה מַחְסֶֽה׃

lines.text: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
In the fear of Jehovah [is] strong confidence, And to His sons there is a refuge.

14.he: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝ס֗וּר מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
The fear of Jehovah [is] a fountain of life, To turn aside from snares of death.

14.he: בְּרָב־עָ֥ם הַדְרַת־מֶ֑לֶךְ וּבְאֶ֥פֶס לְ֝אֹ֗ם מְחִתַּ֥ת רָזֽוֹן׃

lines.text: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
In the multitude of a people [is] the honour of a king, And in lack of people the ruin of a prince.

14.he: אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם רַב־תְּבוּנָ֑ה וּקְצַר־ר֝֗וּחַ מֵרִ֥ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

lines.text: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
Whoso is slow to anger [is] of great understanding, And whoso is short in temper is exalting folly.

14.he: חַיֵּ֣י בְ֭שָׂרִים לֵ֣ב מַרְפֵּ֑א וּרְקַ֖ב עֲצָמ֣וֹת קִנְאָֽה׃

lines.text: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
A healed heart [is] life to the flesh, And rottenness to the bones [is] envy.

14.he: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ וּ֝מְכַבְּד֗וֹ חֹנֵ֥ן אֶבְיֽוֹן׃

lines.text: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
An oppressor of the poor reproacheth his Maker, And whoso is honouring Him Is favouring the needy.

14.he: בְּֽ֭רָעָתוֹ יִדָּחֶ֣ה רָשָׁ֑ע וְחֹסֶ֖ה בְמוֹת֣וֹ צַדִּֽיק׃

lines.text: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
In his wickedness is the wicked driven away, And trustful in his death [is] the righteous.

14.he: בְּלֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן תָּנ֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֑ה וּבְקֶ֥רֶב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים תִּוָּדֵֽעַ׃

lines.text: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.
In the heart of the intelligent wisdom doth rest. And in the midst of fools it is known.

14.he: צְדָקָ֥ה תְרֽוֹמֵֽם־גּ֑וֹי וְחֶ֖סֶד לְאֻמִּ֣ים חַטָּֽאת׃

lines.text: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
Righteousness exalteth a nation, And the goodliness of peoples [is] a sin-offering.

14.he: רְֽצוֹן־מֶ֭לֶךְ לְעֶ֣בֶד מַשְׂכִּ֑יל וְ֝עֶבְרָת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה מֵבִֽישׁ׃

lines.text: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
The favour of a king [is] to a wise servant, And an object of his wrath is one causing shame!

15.he: מַֽעֲנֶה־רַּ֭ךְ יָשִׁ֣יב חֵמָ֑ה וּדְבַר־עֶ֝֗צֶב יַעֲלֶה־אָֽף׃

lines.text: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
A soft answer turneth back fury, And a grievous word raiseth up anger.

15.he: לְשׁ֣וֹן חֲ֭כָמִים תֵּיטִ֣יב דָּ֑עַת וּפִ֥י כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

lines.text: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.
The tongue of the wise maketh knowledge good, And the mouth of fools uttereth folly.

15.he: בְּֽכָל־מָ֭קוֹם עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה צֹ֝פ֗וֹת רָעִ֥ים וטוֹבִֽים׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
In every place are the eyes of Jehovah, Watching the evil and the good.

15.he: מַרְפֵּ֣א לָ֭שׁוֹן עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְסֶ֥לֶף בָּ֝֗הּ שֶׁ֣בֶר בְּרֽוּחַ׃

lines.text: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
A healed tongue [is] a tree of life, And perverseness in it — a breach in the spirit.

15.he: אֱוִ֗יל יִ֭נְאַץ מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יַעְרִֽם׃

lines.text: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
A fool despiseth the instruction of his father, And whoso is regarding reproof is prudent.

15.he: בֵּ֣ית צַ֭דִּיק חֹ֣סֶן רָ֑ב וּבִתְבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע נֶעְכָּֽרֶת׃

lines.text: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.
[In] the house of the righteous [is] abundant strength, And in the increase of the wicked — trouble.

15.he: שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲ֭כָמִים יְזָ֣רוּ דָ֑עַת וְלֵ֖ב כְּסִילִ֣ים לֹא־כֵֽן׃

lines.text: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
The lips of the wise scatter knowledge, And the heart of fools [is] not right.

15.he: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּתְפִלַּ֖ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
The sacrifice of the wicked [is] an abomination to Jehovah, And the prayer of the upright [is] His delight.

15.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ רָשָׁ֑ע וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף צְדָקָ֣ה יֶאֱהָֽב׃

lines.text: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.
An abomination to Jehovah [is] the way of the wicked, And whoso is pursuing righteousness He loveth.

15.he: מוּסָ֣ר רָ֭ע לְעֹזֵ֣ב אֹ֑רַח שׂוֹנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת יָמֽוּת׃

lines.text: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.
Chastisement [is] grievous to him who is forsaking the path, Whoso is hating reproof dieth.

15.he: שְׁא֣וֹל וַ֭אֲבַדּוֹן נֶ֣גֶד יְהוָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־לִבּ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־אָדָֽם׃

lines.text: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
Sheol and destruction [are] before Jehovah, Surely also the hearts of the sons of men.

15.he: לֹ֣א יֶאֱהַב־לֵ֭ץ הוֹכֵ֣חַֽ ל֑וֹ אֶל־חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א יֵלֵֽךְ׃

lines.text: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
A scorner loveth not his reprover, Unto the wise he goeth not.

15.he: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב פָּנִ֑ים וּבְעַצְּבַת־לֵ֝ב ר֣וּחַ נְכֵאָֽה׃

lines.text: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
A joyful heart maketh glad the face, And by grief of heart is the spirit smitten.

15.he: לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יְבַקֶּשׁ־דָּ֑עַת ופני כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יִרְעֶ֥ה אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

lines.text: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
The heart of the intelligent seeketh knowledge, And the mouth of fools enjoyeth folly.

15.he: כָּל־יְמֵ֣י עָנִ֣י רָעִ֑ים וְטֽוֹב־לֵ֝֗ב מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה תָמִֽיד׃

lines.text: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
All the days of the afflicted [are] evil, And gladness of heart [is] a perpetual banquet.

15.he: טוֹב־מְ֭עַט בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה מֵאוֹצָ֥ר רָ֝֗ב וּמְה֥וּמָה בֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.
Better [is] a little with the fear of Jehovah, Than much treasure, and tumult with it.

15.he: ט֤וֹב אֲרֻחַ֣ת יָ֭רָק וְאַהֲבָה־שָׁ֑ם מִשּׁ֥וֹר אָ֝ב֗וּס וְשִׂנְאָה־בֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
Better [is] an allowance of green herbs and love there, Than a fatted ox, and hatred with it.

15.he: אִ֣ישׁ חֵ֭מָה יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וְאֶ֥רֶך אַ֝פַּ֗יִם יַשְׁקִ֥יט רִֽיב׃

lines.text: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
A man of fury stirreth up contention, And the slow to anger appeaseth strife.

15.he: דֶּ֣רֶךְ עָ֭צֵל כִּמְשֻׂ֣כַת חָ֑דֶק וְאֹ֖רַח יְשָׁרִ֣ים סְלֻלָֽה׃

lines.text: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.
The way of the slothful [is] as a hedge of briers, And the path of the upright is raised up.

15.he: בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח־אָ֑ב וּכְסִ֥יל אָ֝דָ֗ם בּוֹזֶ֥ה אִמּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
A wise son rejoiceth a father. And a foolish man is despising his mother.

15.he: אִ֭וֶּלֶת שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַחֲסַר־לֵ֑ב וְאִ֥ישׁ תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה יְיַשֶׁר־לָֽכֶת׃

lines.text: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
Folly is joy to one lacking heart, And a man of intelligence directeth [his] going.

15.he: הָפֵ֣ר מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּאֵ֣ין ס֑וֹד וּבְרֹ֖ב יוֹעֲצִ֣ים תָּקֽוּם׃

lines.text: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
Without counsel [is] the making void of purposes, And in a multitude of counsellors it is established.

15.he: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לָ֭אִישׁ בְּמַעֲנֵה־פִ֑יו וְדָבָ֖ר בְּעִתּ֣וֹ מַה־טּֽוֹב׃

lines.text: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
Joy [is] to a man in the answer of his mouth, And a word in its season — how good!

15.he: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים לְמַ֣עְלָה לְמַשְׂכִּ֑יל לְמַ֥עַן ס֝֗וּר מִשְּׁא֥וֹל מָֽטָּה׃

lines.text: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
A path of life [is] on high for the wise, To turn aside from Sheol beneath.

15.he: בֵּ֣ית גֵּ֭אִים יִסַּ֥ח ׀ יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝יַצֵּ֗ב גְּב֣וּל אַלְמָנָֽה׃

lines.text: Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.
The house of the proud Jehovah pulleth down, And He setteth up the border of the widow.

15.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת רָ֑ע וּ֝טְהֹרִ֗ים אִמְרֵי־נֹֽעַם׃

lines.text: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.
An abomination to Jehovah [are] thoughts of wickedness, And pure [are] sayings of pleasantness.

15.he: עֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וְשׂוֹנֵ֖א מַתָּנֹ֣ת יִחְיֶֽה׃

lines.text: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
A dishonest gainer is troubling his house, And whoso is hating gifts liveth.

15.he: לֵ֣ב צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לַעֲנ֑וֹת וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ רָעֽוֹת׃

lines.text: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
The heart of the righteous meditateth to answer, And the mouth of the wicked uttereth evil things.

15.he: רָח֣וֹק יְ֭הוָה מֵרְשָׁעִ֑ים וּתְפִלַּ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע׃

lines.text: Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
Far [is] Jehovah from the wicked, And the prayer of the righteous He heareth.

15.he: מְֽאוֹר־עֵ֭ינַיִם יְשַׂמַּֽח־לֵ֑ב שְׁמוּעָ֥ה ט֝וֹבָ֗ה תְּדַשֶּׁן־עָֽצֶם׃

lines.text: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart, A good report maketh fat the bone.

15.he: אֹ֗זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת תּוֹכַ֣חַת חַיִּ֑ים בְּקֶ֖רֶב חֲכָמִ֣ים תָּלִֽין׃

lines.text: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
An ear that is hearing the reproof of life Doth lodge among the wise.

15.he: פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מ֭וּסָר מוֹאֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְשׁוֹמֵ֥עַ תּ֝וֹכַ֗חַת ק֣וֹנֶה לֵּֽב׃

lines.text: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
Whoso is refusing instruction is despising his soul, And whoso is hearing reproof Is getting understanding.

15.he: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מוּסַ֣ר חָכְמָ֑ה וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה׃

lines.text: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
The fear of Jehovah [is] the instruction of wisdom, And before honour [is] humility!

16.he: לְאָדָ֥ם מַֽעַרְכֵי־לֵ֑ב וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה מַעֲנֵ֥ה לָשֽׁוֹן׃

lines.text: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.
Of man [are] arrangements of the heart, And from Jehovah an answer of the tongue.

16.he: כָּֽל־דַּרְכֵי־אִ֭ישׁ זַ֣ךְ בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן רוּח֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Yahweh weighs the motives.
All the ways of a man are pure in his own eyes, And Jehovah is pondering the spirits.

16.he: גֹּ֣ל אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝יִכֹּ֗נוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃

lines.text: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
Roll unto Jehovah thy works, And established are thy purposes,

16.he: כֹּ֤ל פָּעַ֣ל יְ֭הוָה לַֽמַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ וְגַם־רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לְי֣וֹם רָעָֽה׃

lines.text: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
All things hath Jehovah wrought for Himself, And also the wicked [worketh] for a day of evil.

16.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל־גְּבַהּ־לֵ֑ב יָ֥ד לְ֝יָ֗ד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃

lines.text: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh: they shall certainly not be unpunished.
An abomination to Jehovah [is] every proud one of heart, Hand to hand he is not acquitted.

16.he: בְּחֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יְכֻפַּ֣ר עָוֺ֑ן וּבְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה ס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃

lines.text: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
In kindness and truth pardoned is iniquity, And in the fear of Jehovah Turn thou aside from evil.

16.he: בִּרְצ֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה דַּרְכֵי־אִ֑ישׁ גַּם־א֝וֹיְבָ֗יו יַשְׁלִ֥ם אִתּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
When a man's ways please Jehovah, even his enemies, He causeth to be at peace with him.

16.he: טוֹב־מְ֭עַט בִּצְדָקָ֑ה מֵרֹ֥ב תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
Better [is] a little with righteousness, Than abundance of increase without justice.

16.he: לֵ֣ב אָ֭דָם יְחַשֵּׁ֣ב דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה יָכִ֥ין צַעֲדֽוֹ׃

lines.text: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
The heart of man deviseth his way, And Jehovah establisheth his step.

16.he: קֶ֤סֶם ׀ עַֽל־שִׂפְתֵי־מֶ֑לֶךְ בְּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט לֹ֣א יִמְעַל־פִּֽיו׃

lines.text: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
An oath [is] on the lips of a king, In judgment his mouth trespasseth not.

16.he: פֶּ֤לֶס ׀ וּמֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭שְׁפָּט לַֽיהוָ֑ה מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ כָּל־אַבְנֵי־כִֽיס׃

lines.text: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
A just beam and balances [are] Jehovah's, His work [are] all the stones of the bag.

16.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת מְ֭לָכִים עֲשׂ֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע כִּ֥י בִ֝צְדָקָ֗ה יִכּ֥וֹן כִּסֵּֽא׃

lines.text: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
An abomination to kings [is] doing wickedness, For by righteousness is a throne established.

16.he: רְצ֣וֹן מְ֭לָכִים שִׂפְתֵי־צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֖ר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יֶאֱהָֽב׃

lines.text: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
The delight of kings [are] righteous lips, And whoso is speaking uprightly he loveth,

16.he: חֲמַת־מֶ֥לֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי־מָ֑וֶת וְאִ֖ישׁ חָכָ֣ם יְכַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃

lines.text: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
The fury of a king [is] messengers of death, And a wise man pacifieth it.

16.he: בְּאוֹר־פְּנֵי־מֶ֥לֶךְ חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ כְּעָ֣ב מַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃

lines.text: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
In the light of a king's face [is] life, And his good-will [is] as a cloud of the latter rain.

16.he: קְֽנֹה־חָכְמָ֗ה מַה־טּ֥וֹב מֵחָר֑וּץ וּקְנ֥וֹת בִּ֝ינָ֗ה נִבְחָ֥ר מִכָּֽסֶף׃

lines.text: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
To get wisdom — how much better than gold, And to get understanding to be chosen than silver!

16.he: מְסִלַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים ס֣וּר מֵרָ֑ע שֹׁמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ נֹצֵ֥ר דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
A highway of the upright [is], 'Turn from evil,' Whoso is preserving his soul is watching his way.

16.he: לִפְנֵי־שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּא֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י כִ֝שָּׁל֗וֹן גֹּ֣בַהּ רֽוּחַ׃

lines.text: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
Before destruction [is] pride, And before stumbling — a haughty spirit.'

16.he: ט֣וֹב שְׁפַל־ר֭וּחַ אֶת־עניים מֵֽחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁ֝לָ֗ל אֶת־גֵּאִֽים׃

lines.text: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
Better is humility of spirit with the poor, Than to apportion spoil with the proud.

16.he: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל עַל־דָּ֭בָר יִמְצָא־ט֑וֹב וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה אַשְׁרָֽיו׃

lines.text: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.
The wise in any matter findeth good, And whoso is trusting in Jehovah, O his happiness.

16.he: לַחֲכַם־לֵ֭ב יִקָּרֵ֣א נָב֑וֹן וּמֶ֥תֶק שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃

lines.text: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
To the wise in heart is called, 'Intelligent,' And sweetness of lips increaseth learning.

16.he: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים שֵׂ֣כֶל בְּעָלָ֑יו וּמוּסַ֖ר אֱוִלִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

lines.text: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
A fountain of life [is] understanding to its possessors, The instruction of fools is folly.

16.he: לֵ֣ב חָ֭כָם יַשְׂכִּ֣יל פִּ֑יהוּ וְעַל־שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃

lines.text: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
The heart of the wise causeth his mouth to act wisely, And by his lips he increaseth learning,

16.he: צוּף־דְּ֭בַשׁ אִמְרֵי־נֹ֑עַם מָת֥וֹק לַ֝נֶּפֶשׁ וּמַרְפֵּ֥א לָעָֽצֶם׃

lines.text: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
Sayings of pleasantness [are] a honeycomb, Sweet to the soul, and healing to the bone.

16.he: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי־מָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
There is a way right before a man, And its latter end — ways of death.

16.he: נֶ֣פֶשׁ עָ֭מֵל עָ֣מְלָה לּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־אָכַ֖ף עָלָ֣יו פִּֽיהוּ׃

lines.text: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him; for his mouth urges him on.
A labouring man hath laboured for himself, For his mouth hath caused [him] to bend over it.

16.he: אִ֣ישׁ בְּ֭לִיַּעַל כֹּרֶ֣ה רָעָ֑ה וְעַל־שפתיו כְּאֵ֣שׁ צָרָֽבֶת׃

lines.text: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
A worthless man is preparing evil, And on his lips — as a burning fire.

16.he: אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֭הְפֻּכוֹת יְשַׁלַּ֣ח מָד֑וֹן וְ֝נִרְגָּ֗ן מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃

lines.text: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
A froward man sendeth forth contention, A tale-bearer is separating a familiar friend.

16.he: אִ֣ישׁ חָ֭מָס יְפַתֶּ֣ה רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝הוֹלִיכ֗וֹ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא־טֽוֹב׃

lines.text: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
A violent man enticeth his neighbour, And hath causeth him to go in a way not good.

16.he: עֹצֶ֣ה עֵ֭ינָיו לַחְשֹׁ֣ב תַּהְפֻּכ֑וֹת קֹרֵ֥ץ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו כִּלָּ֥ה רָעָֽה׃

lines.text: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.
Consulting his eyes to devise froward things, Moving his lips he hath accomplished evil.

16.he: עֲטֶ֣רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת שֵׂיבָ֑ה בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה תִּמָּצֵֽא׃

lines.text: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
A crown of beauty [are] grey hairs, In the way of righteousness it is found.

16.he: ט֤וֹב אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם מִגִּבּ֑וֹר וּמֹשֵׁ֥ל בְּ֝רוּח֗וֹ מִלֹּכֵ֥ד עִֽיר׃

lines.text: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
Better [is] the slow to anger than the mighty, And the ruler over his spirit than he who is taking a city.

16.he: בַּ֭חֵיק יוּטַ֣ל אֶת־הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה כָּל־מִשְׁפָּטֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.
Into the centre is the lot cast, And from Jehovah [is] all its judgment!

17.he: ט֤וֹב פַּ֣ת חֲ֭רֵבָה וְשַׁלְוָה־בָ֑הּ מִ֝בַּ֗יִת מָלֵ֥א זִבְחֵי־רִֽיב׃

lines.text: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
Better [is] a dry morsel, and rest with it, Than a house full of the sacrifices of strife.

17.he: עֶֽבֶד־מַשְׂכִּ֗יל יִ֭מְשֹׁל בְּבֵ֣ן מֵבִ֑ישׁ וּבְת֥וֹךְ אַ֝חִ֗ים יַחֲלֹ֥ק נַחֲלָֽה׃

lines.text: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.
A wise servant ruleth over a son causing shame, And in the midst of brethren He apportioneth an inheritance.

17.he: מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭כֶּסֶף וְכ֣וּר לַזָּהָ֑ב וּבֹחֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.
A refining pot [is] for silver, and a furnace for gold, And the trier of hearts [is] Jehovah.

17.he: מֵ֭רַע מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל־שְׂפַת־אָ֑וֶן שֶׁ֥קֶר מֵ֝זִין עַל־לְשׁ֥וֹן הַוֺּֽת׃

lines.text: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
An evil doer is attentive to lips of vanity, Falsehood is giving ear to a mischievous tongue.

17.he: לֹעֵ֣ג לָ֭רָשׁ חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ שָׂמֵ֥חַ לְ֝אֵ֗יד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃

lines.text: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
Whoso is mocking at the poor Hath reproached his Maker, Whoso is rejoicing at calamity is not acquitted.

17.he: עֲטֶ֣רֶת זְ֭קֵנִים בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים וְתִפְאֶ֖רֶת בָּנִ֣ים אֲבוֹתָֽם׃

lines.text: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents.
Sons' sons [are] the crown of old men, And the glory of sons [are] their fathers.

17.he: לֹא־נָאוָ֣ה לְנָבָ֣ל שְׂפַת־יֶ֑תֶר אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־לְנָדִ֥יב שְׂפַת־שָֽׁקֶר׃

lines.text: Arrogant speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.
Not comely for a fool is a lip of excellency, Much less for a noble a lip of falsehood.

17.he: אֶֽבֶן־חֵ֣ן הַ֭שֹּׁחַד בְּעֵינֵ֣י בְעָלָ֑יו אֶֽל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִפְנֶ֣ה יַשְׂכִּֽיל׃

lines.text: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
A stone of grace [is] the bribe in the eyes of its possessors, Whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.

17.he: מְֽכַסֶּה־פֶּ֭שַׁע מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אַהֲבָ֑ה וְשֹׁנֶ֥ה בְ֝דָבָ֗ר מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃

lines.text: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
Whoso is covering transgression is seeking love, And whoso is repeating a matter Is separating a familiar friend.

17.he: תֵּ֣חַת גְּעָרָ֣ה בְמֵבִ֑ין מֵהַכּ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל מֵאָֽה׃

lines.text: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
Rebuke cometh down on the intelligent More than a hundred stripes on a fool.

17.he: אַךְ־מְרִ֥י יְבַקֶּשׁ־רָ֑ע וּמַלְאָ֥ךְ אַ֝כְזָרִ֗י יְשֻׁלַּח־בּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
An evil man seeketh only rebellion, And a fierce messenger is sent against him.

17.he: פָּג֬וֹשׁ דֹּ֣ב שַׁכּ֣וּל בְּאִ֑ישׁ וְאַל־כְּ֝סִ֗יל בְּאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
The meeting of a bereaved bear by a man, And — not a fool in his folly.

17.he: מֵשִׁ֣יב רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה לֹא־תמיש רָ֝עָ֗ה מִבֵּיתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
Whoso is returning evil for good, Evil moveth not from his house.

17.he: פּ֣וֹטֵֽר מַ֭יִם רֵאשִׁ֣ית מָד֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י הִ֝תְגַּלַּ֗ע הָרִ֥יב נְטֽוֹשׁ׃

lines.text: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
The beginning of contention [is] a letting out of waters, And before it is meddled with leave the strife.

17.he: מַצְדִּ֣יק רָ֭שָׁע וּמַרְשִׁ֣יעַ צַדִּ֑יק תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
Whoso is justifying the wicked, And condemning the righteous, Even both of these [are] an abomination to Jehovah.

17.he: לָמָּה־זֶּ֣ה מְחִ֣יר בְּיַד־כְּסִ֑יל לִקְנ֖וֹת חָכְמָ֣ה וְלֶב־אָֽיִן׃

lines.text: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
Why [is] this — a price in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, And a heart there is none?

17.he: בְּכָל־עֵ֭ת אֹהֵ֣ב הָרֵ֑עַ וְאָ֥ח לְ֝צָרָ֗ה יִוָּלֵֽד׃

lines.text: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
At all times is the friend loving, And a brother for adversity is born.

17.he: אָדָ֣ם חֲסַר־לֵ֭ב תּוֹקֵ֣עַ כָּ֑ף עֹרֵ֥ב עֲ֝רֻבָּ֗ה לִפְנֵ֥י רֵעֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
A man lacking heart is striking hands, A surety he becometh before his friend.

17.he: אֹ֣הֵֽב פֶּ֭שַׁע אֹהֵ֣ב מַצָּ֑ה מַגְבִּ֥יהַּ פִּ֝תְח֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־שָֽׁבֶר׃

lines.text: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.
Whoso is loving transgression is loving debate, Whoso is making high his entrance is seeking destruction.

17.he: עִקֶּשׁ־לֵ֭ב לֹ֣א יִמְצָא־ט֑וֹב וְנֶהְפָּ֥ךְ בִּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּרָעָֽה׃

lines.text: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.
The perverse of heart findeth not good, And the turned in his tongue falleth into evil.

17.he: יֹלֵ֣ד כְּ֭סִיל לְת֣וּגָה ל֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח אֲבִ֣י נָבָֽל׃

lines.text: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
Whoso is begetting a fool hath affliction for it, Yea, the father of a fool rejoiceth not.

17.he: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב גֵּהָ֑ה וְר֥וּחַ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה תְּיַבֶּשׁ־גָּֽרֶם׃

lines.text: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
A rejoicing heart doth good to the body, And a smitten spirit drieth the bone.

17.he: שֹׁ֣חַד מֵ֭חֵיק רָשָׁ֣ע יִקָּ֑ח לְ֝הַטּ֗וֹת אָרְח֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
A bribe from the bosom the wicked taketh, To turn aside the paths of judgment.

17.he: אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י מֵבִ֣ין חָכְמָ֑ה וְעֵינֵ֥י כְ֝סִ֗יל בִּקְצֵה־אָֽרֶץ׃

lines.text: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
The face of the intelligent [is] to wisdom, And the eyes of a fool — at the end of the earth.

17.he: כַּ֣עַס לְ֭אָבִיו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וּ֝מֶ֗מֶר לְיוֹלַדְתּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
A provocation to his father [is] a foolish son, And bitterness to her that bare him.

17.he: גַּ֤ם עֲנ֣וֹשׁ לַצַּדִּ֣יק לֹא־ט֑וֹב לְהַכּ֖וֹת נְדִיבִ֣ים עַל־יֹֽשֶׁר׃

lines.text: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
Also, to fine the righteous is not good, To smite nobles for uprightness.

17.he: חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ אֲ֭מָרָיו יוֹדֵ֣עַ דָּ֑עַת וקר־ר֝֗וּחַ אִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה׃

lines.text: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
One acquainted with knowledge is sparing his words, And the cool of temper [is] a man of understanding.

17.he: גַּ֤ם אֱוִ֣יל מַ֭חֲרִישׁ חָכָ֣ם יֵחָשֵׁ֑ב אֹטֵ֖ם שְׂפָתָ֣יו נָבֽוֹן׃

lines.text: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
Even a fool keeping silence is reckoned wise, He who is shutting his lips intelligent!

18.he: לְֽ֭תַאֲוָה יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ נִפְרָ֑ד בְּכָל־תּ֝וּשִׁיָּ֗ה יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃

lines.text: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
For [an object of] desire he who is separated doth seek, With all wisdom he intermeddleth.

18.he: לֹֽא־יַחְפֹּ֣ץ כְּ֭סִיל בִּתְבוּנָ֑ה כִּ֝֗י אִֽם־בְּהִתְגַּלּ֥וֹת לִבּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
A fool delighteth not in understanding, But — in uncovering his heart.

18.he: בְּֽבוֹא־רָ֭שָׁע בָּ֣א גַם־בּ֑וּז וְֽעִם־קָל֥וֹן חֶרְפָּֽה׃

lines.text: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.
With the coming of the wicked come also hath contempt, And with shame — reproach.

18.he: מַ֣יִם עֲ֭מֻקִּים דִּבְרֵ֣י פִי־אִ֑ישׁ נַ֥חַל נֹ֝בֵ֗עַ מְק֣וֹר חָכְמָֽה׃

lines.text: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
Deep waters [are] the words of a man's mouth, The fountain of wisdom [is] a flowing brook.

18.he: שְׂאֵ֣ת פְּנֵי־רָשָׁ֣ע לֹא־ט֑וֹב לְהַטּ֥וֹת צַ֝דִּ֗יק בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
Acceptance of the face of the wicked [is] not good, To turn aside the righteous in judgment.

18.he: שִׂפְתֵ֣י כְ֭סִיל יָבֹ֣אֽוּ בְרִ֑יב וּ֝פִ֗יו לְֽמַהֲלֻמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא׃

lines.text: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
The lips of a fool enter into strife, And his mouth for stripes calleth.

18.he: פִּֽי־כְ֭סִיל מְחִתָּה־ל֑וֹ וּ֝שְׂפָתָ֗יו מוֹקֵ֥שׁ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
The mouth of a fool [is] ruin to him, And his lips [are] the snare of his soul.

18.he: דִּבְרֵ֣י נִ֭רְגָּן כְּמִֽתְלַהֲמִ֑ים וְ֝הֵ֗ם יָרְד֥וּ חַדְרֵי־בָֽטֶן׃

lines.text: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
The words of a tale-bearer [are] as self-inflicted wounds, And they have gone down [to] the inner parts of the heart.

18.he: גַּ֭ם מִתְרַפֶּ֣ה בִמְלַאכְתּ֑וֹ אָ֥ח ה֝֗וּא לְבַ֣עַל מַשְׁחִֽית׃

lines.text: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
He also that is remiss in his work, A brother he [is] to a destroyer.

18.he: מִגְדַּל־עֹ֭ז שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בּֽוֹ־יָר֖וּץ צַדִּ֣יק וְנִשְׂגָּֽב׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
A tower of strength [is] the name of Jehovah, Into it the righteous runneth, and is set on high.

18.he: ה֣וֹן עָ֭שִׁיר קִרְיַ֣ת עֻזּ֑וֹ וּכְחוֹמָ֥ה נִ֝שְׂגָּבָ֗ה בְּמַשְׂכִּיתֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
The wealth of the rich [is] the city of his strength, And as a wall set on high in his own imagination.

18.he: לִפְנֵי־שֶׁ֭בֶר יִגְבַּ֣הּ לֵב־אִ֑ישׁ וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה׃

lines.text: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
Before destruction the heart of man is high, And before honour [is] humility.

18.he: מֵשִׁ֣יב דָּ֭בָר בְּטֶ֣רֶם יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִוֶּ֥לֶת הִיא־ל֝֗וֹ וּכְלִמָּֽה׃

lines.text: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
Whoso is answering a matter before he heareth, Folly it is to him and shame.

18.he: רֽוּחַ־אִ֭ישׁ יְכַלְכֵּ֣ל מַחֲלֵ֑הוּ וְר֥וּחַ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה מִ֣י יִשָּׂאֶֽנָּה׃

lines.text: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
The spirit of a man sustaineth his sickness, And a smitten spirit who doth bear?

18.he: לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יִקְנֶה־דָּ֑עַת וְאֹ֥זֶן חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים תְּבַקֶּשׁ־דָּֽעַת׃

lines.text: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
The heart of the intelligent getteth knowledge, And the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

18.he: מַתָּ֣ן אָ֭דָם יַרְחִ֣יב ל֑וֹ וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְדֹלִ֣ים יַנְחֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
The gift of a man maketh room for him, And before the great it leadeth him.

18.he: צַדִּ֣יק הָרִאשׁ֣וֹן בְּרִיב֑וֹ יבא־רֵ֝עֵ֗הוּ וַחֲקָרֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He who pleads his cause first seems right; until another comes and questions him.
Righteous [is] the first in his own cause, His neighbour cometh and hath searched him.

18.he: מִ֭דְיָנִים יַשְׁבִּ֣ית הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּבֵ֖ין עֲצוּמִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיד׃

lines.text: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
The lot causeth contentions to cease, And between the mighty it separateth.

18.he: אָ֗ח נִפְשָׁ֥ע מִקִּרְיַת־עֹ֑ז ומדונים כִּבְרִ֥יחַ אַרְמֽוֹן׃

lines.text: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.
A brother transgressed against is as a strong city, And contentions as the bar of a palace.

18.he: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי־אִ֭ישׁ תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע בִּטְנ֑וֹ תְּבוּאַ֖ת שְׂפָתָ֣יו יִשְׂבָּֽע׃

lines.text: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
From the fruit of a man's mouth is his belly satisfied, [From the] increase of his lips he is satisfied.

18.he: מָ֣וֶת וְ֭חַיִּים בְּיַד־לָשׁ֑וֹן וְ֝אֹהֲבֶ֗יהָ יֹאכַ֥ל פִּרְיָֽהּ׃

lines.text: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
Death and life [are] in the power of the tongue, And those loving it eat its fruit.

18.he: מָצָ֣א אִ֭שָּׁה מָ֣צָא ט֑וֹב וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.
[Whoso] hath found a wife hath found good, And bringeth out good-will from Jehovah.

18.he: תַּחֲנוּנִ֥ים יְדַבֶּר־רָ֑שׁ וְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר יַעֲנֶ֥ה עַזּֽוֹת׃

lines.text: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
[With] supplications doth the poor speak, And the rich answereth fierce things.

18.he: אִ֣ישׁ רֵ֭עִים לְהִתְרֹעֵ֑עַ וְיֵ֥שׁ אֹ֝הֵ֗ב דָּבֵ֥ק מֵאָֽח׃

lines.text: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
A man with friends [is] to show himself friendly, And there is a lover adhering more than a brother!

19.he: טֽוֹב־רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֑וֹ מֵעִקֵּ֥שׁ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו וְה֣וּא כְסִֽיל׃

lines.text: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
Better [is] the poor walking in his integrity, Than the perverse [in] his lips, who [is] a fool.

19.he: גַּ֤ם בְּלֹא־דַ֣עַת נֶ֣פֶשׁ לֹא־ט֑וֹב וְאָ֖ץ בְּרַגְלַ֣יִם חוֹטֵֽא׃

lines.text: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor being hasty with one’s feet and missing the way.
Also, without knowledge the soul [is] not good, And the hasty in feet is sinning.

19.he: אִוֶּ֣לֶת אָ֭דָם תְּסַלֵּ֣ף דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְעַל־יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִזְעַ֥ף לִבּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.
The folly of man perverteth his way, And against Jehovah is his heart wroth.

19.he: ה֗וֹן יֹ֭סִיף רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝דָ֗ל מֵרֵ֥עהוּ יִפָּרֵֽד׃

lines.text: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
Wealth addeth many friends, And the poor from his neighbour is separated.

19.he: עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִמָּלֵֽט׃

lines.text: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
A false witness is not acquitted, Whoso breatheth out lies is not delivered.

19.he: רַ֭בִּים יְחַלּ֣וּ פְנֵֽי־נָדִ֑יב וְכָל־הָ֝רֵ֗עַ לְאִ֣ישׁ מַתָּֽן׃

lines.text: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
Many entreat the face of the noble, And all have made friendship to a man of gifts.

19.he: כָּ֥ל אֲחֵי־רָ֨שׁ ׀ שְֽׂנֵאֻ֗הוּ אַ֤ף כִּ֣י מְ֭רֵעֵהוּ רָחֲק֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ מְרַדֵּ֖ף אֲמָרִ֣ים לא־הֵֽמָּה׃

lines.text: All the relatives of the poor shun him: how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.
All the brethren of the poor have hated him, Surely also his friends have been far from him, He is pursuing words — they are not!

19.he: קֹֽנֶה־לֵּ֭ב אֹהֵ֣ב נַפְשׁ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֥ר תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה לִמְצֹא־טֽוֹב׃

lines.text: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
Whoso is getting heart is loving his soul, He is keeping understanding to find good.

19.he: עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֖יחַ כְּזָבִ֣ים יֹאבֵֽד׃

lines.text: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
A false witness is not acquitted, And whoso breatheth out lies perisheth.

19.he: לֹֽא־נָאוֶ֣ה לִכְסִ֣יל תַּעֲנ֑וּג אַ֝ף כִּֽי־לְעֶ֤בֶד ׀ מְשֹׁ֬ל בְּשָׂרִֽים׃

lines.text: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
Luxury is not comely for a fool, Much less for a servant to rule among princes.

19.he: שֵׂ֣כֶל אָ֭דָם הֶאֱרִ֣יךְ אַפּ֑וֹ וְ֝תִפאַרְתּ֗וֹ עֲבֹ֣ר עַל־פָּֽשַׁע׃

lines.text: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
The wisdom of a man hath deferred his anger, And his glory [is] to pass over transgression.

19.he: נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר זַ֣עַף מֶ֑לֶךְ וּכְטַ֖ל עַל־עֵ֣שֶׂב רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
The wrath of a king [is] a growl as of a young lion, And as dew on the herb his good-will.

19.he: הַוֺּ֣ת לְ֭אָבִיו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וְדֶ֥לֶף טֹ֝רֵ֗ד מִדְיְנֵ֥י אִשָּֽׁה׃

lines.text: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
A calamity to his father [is] a foolish son, And the contentions of a wife [are] a continual dropping.

19.he: בַּ֣יִת וָ֭הוֹן נַחֲלַ֣ת אָב֑וֹת וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה אִשָּׁ֥ה מַשְׂכָּֽלֶת׃

lines.text: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.
House and wealth [are] the inheritance of fathers, And from Jehovah [is] an understanding wife.

19.he: עַ֭צְלָה תַּפִּ֣יל תַּרְדֵּמָ֑ה וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ רְמִיָּ֣ה תִרְעָֽב׃

lines.text: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
Sloth causeth deep sleep to fall, And an indolent soul doth hunger.

19.he: שֹׁמֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑וֹ בּוֹזֵ֖ה דְרָכָ֣יו יומת׃

lines.text: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
Whoso is keeping the command is keeping his soul, Whoso is despising His ways dieth.

19.he: מַלְוֵ֣ה יְ֭הוָה ח֣וֹנֵֽן דָּ֑ל וּ֝גְמֻל֗וֹ יְשַׁלֶּם־לֽוֹ׃

lines.text: He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.
Whoso is lending [to] Jehovah is favouring the poor, And his deed He repayeth to him.

19.he: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ כִּי־יֵ֣שׁ תִּקְוָ֑ה וְאֶל־הֲ֝מִית֗וֹ אַל־תִּשָּׂ֥א נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

lines.text: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
Chastise thy son, for there is hope, And to put him to death lift not up thy soul.

19.he: גרל־חֵ֭מָה נֹ֣שֵׂא עֹ֑נֶשׁ כִּ֥י אִם־תַּ֝צִּ֗יל וְע֣וֹד תּוֹסִֽף׃

lines.text: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
A man of great wrath is bearing punishment, For, if thou dost deliver, yet again thou dost add.

19.he: שְׁמַ֣ע עֵ֭צָה וְקַבֵּ֣ל מוּסָ֑ר לְ֝מַ֗עַן תֶּחְכַּ֥ם בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ׃

lines.text: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
Hear counsel and receive instruction, So that thou art wise in thy latter end.

19.he: רַבּ֣וֹת מַחֲשָׁב֣וֹת בְּלֶב־אִ֑ישׁ וַעֲצַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תָקֽוּם׃

lines.text: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
Many [are] the purposes in a man's heart, And the counsel of Jehovah it standeth.

19.he: תַּאֲוַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְטֽוֹב־רָ֝שׁ מֵאִ֥ישׁ כָּזָֽב׃

lines.text: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
The desirableness of a man [is] his kindness, And better [is] the poor than a liar.

19.he: יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה לְחַיִּ֑ים וְשָׂבֵ֥עַ יָ֝לִ֗ין בַּל־יִפָּ֥קֶד רָֽע׃

lines.text: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
The fear of Jehovah [is] to life, And satisfied he remaineth — he is not charged with evil.

19.he: טָ֘מַ֤ן עָצֵ֣ל יָ֭דוֹ בַּצַּלָּ֑חַת גַּם־אֶל־פִּ֝֗יהוּ לֹ֣א יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃

lines.text: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
The slothful hath hidden his hand in a dish, Even unto his mouth he bringeth it not back.

19.he: לֵ֣ץ תַּ֭כֶּה וּפֶ֣תִי יַעְרִ֑ם וְהוֹכִ֥יחַ לְ֝נָב֗וֹן יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת׃

lines.text: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
A scorner smite, and the simple acts prudently, And give reproof to the intelligent, He understandeth knowledge.

19.he: מְֽשַׁדֶּד־אָ֭ב יַבְרִ֣יחַ אֵ֑ם בֵּ֝֗ן מֵבִ֥ישׁ וּמַחְפִּֽיר׃

lines.text: He who robs his father and drives away his mother, is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
Whoso is spoiling a father causeth a mother to flee, A son causing shame, and bringing confusion.

19.he: חַֽדַל־בְּ֭נִי לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר לִ֝שְׁג֗וֹת מֵֽאִמְרֵי־דָֽעַת׃

lines.text: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
Cease, my son, to hear instruction — To err from sayings of knowledge.

19.he: עֵ֣ד בְּ֭לִיַּעַל יָלִ֣יץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְבַלַּע־אָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
A worthless witness scorneth judgment, And the mouth of the wicked swalloweth iniquity.

19.he: נָכ֣וֹנוּ לַלֵּצִ֣ים שְׁפָטִ֑ים וּ֝מַהֲלֻמ֗וֹת לְגֵ֣ו כְסִילִֽים׃

lines.text: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
Judgments have been prepared for scorners, And stripes for the back of fools!

20.he: לֵ֣ץ הַ֭יַּין הֹמֶ֣ה שֵׁכָ֑ר וְכָל־שֹׁ֥גֶה בּ֝֗וֹ לֹ֣א יֶחְכָּֽם׃

lines.text: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
Wine [is] a scorner — strong drink [is] noisy, And any going astray in it is not wise.

20.he: נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר אֵ֣ימַת מֶ֑לֶךְ מִ֝תְעַבְּר֗וֹ חוֹטֵ֥א נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
The fear of a king [is] a growl as of a young lion, He who is causing him to be wroth is wronging his soul.

20.he: כָּב֣וֹד לָ֭אִישׁ שֶׁ֣בֶת מֵרִ֑יב וְכָל־אֱ֝וִ֗יל יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃

lines.text: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.
An honour to a man is cessation from strife, And every fool intermeddleth.

20.he: מֵ֭חֹרֶף עָצֵ֣ל לֹא־יַחֲרֹ֑שׁ ישאל בַּקָּצִ֣יר וָאָֽיִן׃

lines.text: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
Because of winter the slothful plougheth not, He asketh in harvest, and there is nothing.

20.he: מַ֣יִם עֲ֭מֻקִּים עֵצָ֣ה בְלֶב־אִ֑ישׁ וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנָ֣ה יִדְלֶֽנָּה׃

lines.text: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.
Counsel in the heart of a man [is] deep water, And a man of understanding draweth it up.

20.he: רָב־אָדָ֗ם יִ֭קְרָא אִ֣ישׁ חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִ֣י יִמְצָֽא׃

lines.text: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
A multitude of men proclaim each his kindness, And a man of stedfastness who doth find?

20.he: מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֣וֹ צַדִּ֑יק אַשְׁרֵ֖י בָנָ֣יו אַחֲרָֽיו׃

lines.text: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
The righteous is walking habitually in his integrity, O the happiness of his sons after him!

20.he: מֶ֗לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־כִּסֵּא־דִ֑ין מְזָרֶ֖ה בְעֵינָ֣יו כָּל־רָֽע׃

lines.text: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
A king sitting on a throne of judgment, Is scattering with his eyes all evil,

20.he: מִֽי־יֹ֭אמַר זִכִּ֣יתִי לִבִּ֑י טָ֝הַ֗רְתִּי מֵחַטָּאתִֽי׃

lines.text: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin?”
Who saith, 'I have purified my heart, I have been cleansed from my sin?'

20.he: אֶ֣בֶן וָ֭אֶבֶן אֵיפָ֣ה וְאֵיפָ֑ה תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
A stone and a stone, an ephah and an ephah, Even both of them [are] an abomination to Jehovah.

20.he: גַּ֣ם בְּ֭מַעֲלָלָיו יִתְנַכֶּר־נָ֑עַר אִם־זַ֖ךְ וְאִם־יָשָׁ֣ר פָּעֳלֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.
Even by his actions a youth maketh himself known, Whether his work be pure or upright.

20.he: אֹ֣זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת וְעַ֣יִן רֹאָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה גַם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

lines.text: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.
A hearing ear, and a seeing eye, Jehovah hath made even both of them.

20.he: אַל־תֶּֽאֱהַ֣ב שֵׁ֭נָה פֶּן־תִּוָּרֵ֑שׁ פְּקַ֖ח עֵינֶ֣יךָ שְֽׂבַֽע־לָֽחֶם׃

lines.text: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
Love not sleep, lest thou become poor, Open thine eyes — be satisfied [with] bread.

20.he: רַ֣ע רַ֭ע יֹאמַ֣ר הַקּוֹנֶ֑ה וְאֹזֵ֥ל ל֝֗וֹ אָ֣ז יִתְהַלָּֽל׃

lines.text: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
'Bad, bad,' saith the buyer, And going his way then he boasteth himself.

20.he: יֵ֣שׁ זָ֭הָב וְרָב־פְּנִינִ֑ים וּכְלִ֥י יְ֝קָ֗ר שִׂפְתֵי־דָֽעַת׃

lines.text: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
Substance, gold, and a multitude of rubies, Yea, a precious vessel, [are] lips of knowledge.

20.he: לְֽקַח־בִּ֭גְדוֹ כִּי־עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וּבְעַ֖ד נכרים חַבְלֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
Take his garment when a stranger hath been surety, And for strangers pledge it.

20.he: עָרֵ֣ב לָ֭אִישׁ לֶ֣חֶם שָׁ֑קֶר וְ֝אַחַ֗ר יִמָּֽלֵא־פִ֥יהוּ חָצָֽץ׃

lines.text: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
Sweet to a man [is] the bread of falsehood, And afterwards is his mouth filled [with] gravel.

20.he: מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּעֵצָ֣ה תִכּ֑וֹן וּ֝בְתַחְבֻּל֗וֹת עֲשֵׂ֣ה מִלְחָמָֽה׃

lines.text: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
Purposes by counsel thou dost establish, And with plans make thou war.

20.he: גּֽוֹלֶה־סּ֭וֹד הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָכִ֑יל וּלְפֹתֶ֥ה שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִתְעָרָֽב׃

lines.text: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
A revealer of secret counsels is the busybody, And for a deceiver [with] his lips make not thyself surety.

20.he: מְ֭קַלֵּל אָבִ֣יו וְאִמּ֑וֹ יִֽדְעַ֥ךְ נֵ֝ר֗וֹ באישון חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

lines.text: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
Whoso is vilifying his father and his mother, Extinguished is his lamp in blackness of darkness.

20.he: נַ֭חֲלָה מבחלת בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ לֹ֣א תְבֹרָֽךְ׃

lines.text: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning, won’t be blessed in the end.
An inheritance gotten wrongly at first, Even its latter end is not blessed.

20.he: אַל־תֹּאמַ֥ר אֲשַׁלְּמָה־רָ֑ע קַוֵּ֥ה לַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה וְיֹ֣שַֽׁע לָֽךְ׃

lines.text: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.
Do not say, 'I recompense evil,' Wait for Jehovah, and He delivereth thee.

20.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה אֶ֣בֶן וָאָ֑בֶן וּמֹאזְנֵ֖י מִרְמָ֣ה לֹא־טֽוֹב׃

lines.text: Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
An abomination to Jehovah [are] a stone and a stone, And balances of deceit [are] not good.

20.he: מֵיהוָ֥ה מִצְעֲדֵי־גָ֑בֶר וְ֝אָדָ֗ם מַה־יָּבִ֥ין דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃

lines.text: A man’s steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?
From Jehovah [are] the steps of a man, And man — how understandeth he his way?

20.he: מוֹקֵ֣שׁ אָ֭דָם יָ֣לַע קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְאַחַ֖ר נְדָרִ֣ים לְבַקֵּֽר׃

lines.text: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.
A snare to a man [is] he hath swallowed a holy thing, And after vows to make inquiry.

20.he: מְזָרֶ֣ה רְ֭שָׁעִים מֶ֣לֶךְ חָכָ֑ם וַיָּ֖שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם אוֹפָֽן׃

lines.text: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
A wise king is scattering the wicked, And turneth back on them the wheel.

20.he: נֵ֣ר יְ֭הוָה נִשְׁמַ֣ת אָדָ֑ם חֹ֝פֵ֗שׂ כָּל־חַדְרֵי־בָֽטֶן׃

lines.text: The spirit of man is Yahweh’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
The breath of man [is] a lamp of Jehovah, Searching all the inner parts of the heart.

20.he: חֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יִצְּרוּ־מֶ֑לֶךְ וְסָעַ֖ד בַּחֶ֣סֶד כִּסְאֽוֹ׃

lines.text: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
Kindness and truth keep a king, And he hath supported by kindness his throne.

20.he: תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בַּחוּרִ֣ים כֹּחָ֑ם וַהֲדַ֖ר זְקֵנִ֣ים שֵׂיבָֽה׃

lines.text: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
The beauty of young men is their strength, And the honour of old men is grey hairs.

20.he: חַבֻּר֣וֹת פֶּ֭צַע תמריק בְּרָ֑ע וּ֝מַכּ֗וֹת חַדְרֵי־בָֽטֶן׃

lines.text: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
The bandages of a wound thou removest with the evil, Also the plagues of the inner parts of the heart!

21.he: פַּלְגֵי־מַ֣יִם לֶב־מֶ֭לֶךְ בְּיַד־יְהוָ֑ה עַֽל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֖ר יַחְפֹּ֣ץ יַטֶּֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
Rivulets of waters [is] the heart of a king in the hand of Jehovah, Wherever He pleaseth He inclineth it.

21.he: כָּֽל־דֶּרֶךְ־אִ֭ישׁ יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the hearts.
Every way of a man [is] right in his own eyes, And Jehovah is pondering hearts.

21.he: עֲ֭שֹׂה צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נִבְחָ֖ר לַיהוָ֣ה מִזָּֽבַח׃

lines.text: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
To do righteousness and judgment, Is chosen of Jehovah rather than sacrifice.

21.he: רוּם־עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַב־לֵ֑ב נִ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים חַטָּֽאת׃

lines.text: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
Loftiness of eyes, and breadth of heart, Tillage of the wicked [is] sin.

21.he: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת חָ֭רוּץ אַךְ־לְמוֹתָ֑ר וְכָל־אָ֝֗ץ אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃

lines.text: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
The purposes of the diligent [are] only to advantage, And of every hasty one, only to want.

21.he: פֹּ֣עַל א֭וֹצָרוֹת בִּלְשׁ֣וֹן שָׁ֑קֶר הֶ֥בֶל נִ֝דָּ֗ף מְבַקְשֵׁי־מָֽוֶת׃

lines.text: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
The making of treasures by a lying tongue, [Is] a vanity driven away of those seeking death.

21.he: שֹׁד־רְשָׁעִ֥ים יְגוֹרֵ֑ם כִּ֥י מֵ֝אֲנ֗וּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

lines.text: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
The spoil of the wicked catcheth them, Because they have refused to do judgment.

21.he: הֲפַכְפַּ֬ךְ דֶּ֣רֶךְ אִ֣ישׁ וָזָ֑ר וְ֝זַ֗ךְ יָשָׁ֥ר פָּעֳלֽוֹ׃

lines.text: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
Froward [is] the way of a man who is vile, And the pure — upright [is] his work.

21.he: ט֗וֹב לָשֶׁ֥בֶת עַל־פִּנַּת־גָּ֑ג מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים וּבֵ֥ית חָֽבֶר׃

lines.text: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
Better to sit on a corner of the roof, Than [with] a woman of contentions and a house of company.

21.he: נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָ֭שָׁע אִוְּתָה־רָ֑ע לֹא־יֻחַ֖ן בְּעֵינָ֣יו רֵעֵֽהוּ׃

lines.text: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
The soul of the wicked hath desired evil, Not gracious in his eyes is his neighbour.

21.he: בַּעְנָשׁ־לֵ֭ץ יֶחְכַּם־פֶּ֑תִי וּבְהַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְ֝חָכָ֗ם יִקַּח־דָּֽעַת׃

lines.text: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
When the scorner is punished, the simple becometh wise, And in giving understanding to the wise He receiveth knowledge.

21.he: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל צַ֭דִּיק לְבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע מְסַלֵּ֖ף רְשָׁעִ֣ים לָרָֽע׃

lines.text: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
The Righteous One is acting wisely Towards the house of the wicked, He is overthrowing the wicked for wickedness.

21.he: אֹטֵ֣ם אָ֭זְנוֹ מִזַּעֲקַת־דָּ֑ל גַּֽם־ה֥וּא יִ֝קְרָ֗א וְלֹ֣א יֵעָנֶֽה׃

lines.text: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
Whoso is shutting his ear from the cry of the poor, He also doth cry, and is not answered.

21.he: מַתָּ֣ן בַּ֭סֵּתֶר יִכְפֶּה־אָ֑ף וְשֹׁ֥חַד בַּ֝חֵ֗ק חֵמָ֥ה עַזָּֽה׃

lines.text: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
A gift in secret pacifieth anger, And a bribe in the bosom strong fury.

21.he: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַ֭צַּדִּיק עֲשׂ֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

lines.text: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
To do justice [is] joy to the righteous, But ruin to workers of iniquity.

21.he: אָדָ֗ם תּ֭וֹעֶה מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל בִּקְהַ֖ל רְפָאִ֣ים יָנֽוּחַ׃

lines.text: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.
A man who is wandering from the way of understanding, In an assembly of Rephaim resteth.

21.he: אִ֣ישׁ מַ֭חְסוֹר אֹהֵ֣ב שִׂמְחָ֑ה אֹהֵ֥ב יַֽיִן־וָ֝שֶׁ֗מֶן לֹ֣א יַעֲשִֽׁיר׃

lines.text: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.
Whoso [is] loving mirth [is] a poor man, Whoso is loving wine and oil maketh no wealth.

21.he: כֹּ֣פֶר לַצַּדִּ֣יק רָשָׁ֑ע וְתַ֖חַת יְשָׁרִ֣ים בּוֹגֵֽד׃

lines.text: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.
The wicked [is] an atonement for the righteous, And for the upright the treacherous dealer.

21.he: ט֗וֹב שֶׁ֥בֶת בְּאֶֽרֶץ־מִדְבָּ֑ר מֵאֵ֖שֶׁת מדונים וָכָֽעַס׃

lines.text: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
Better to dwell in a wilderness land, Than [with] a woman of contentions and anger.

21.he: אוֹצָ֤ר ׀ נֶחְמָ֣ד וָ֭שֶׁמֶן בִּנְוֵ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וּכְסִ֖יל אָדָ֣ם יְבַלְּעֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man swallows it up.
A treasure to be desired, and oil, [Is] in the habitation of the wise, And a foolish man swalloweth it up.

21.he: רֹ֭דֵף צְדָקָ֣ה וָחָ֑סֶד יִמְצָ֥א חַ֝יִּ֗ים צְדָקָ֥ה וְכָבֽוֹד׃

lines.text: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
Whoso is pursuing righteousness and kindness, Findeth life, righteousness, and honour.

21.he: עִ֣יר גִּ֭בֹּרִים עָלָ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗רֶד עֹ֣ז מִבְטֶחָֽה׃

lines.text: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
A city of the mighty hath the wise gone up, And bringeth down the strength of its confidence.

21.he: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פִּ֭יו וּלְשׁוֹנ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֖ר מִצָּר֣וֹת נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

lines.text: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
Whoso is keeping his mouth and his tongue, Is keeping from adversities his soul.

21.he: זֵ֣ד יָ֭הִיר לֵ֣ץ שְׁמ֑וֹ ע֝וֹשֶׂ֗ה בְּעֶבְרַ֥ת זָדֽוֹן׃

lines.text: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
Proud, haughty, scorner [is] his name, Who is working in the wrath of pride.

21.he: תַּאֲוַ֣ת עָצֵ֣ל תְּמִיתֶ֑נּוּ כִּֽי־מֵאֲנ֖וּ יָדָ֣יו לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

lines.text: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
The desire of the slothful slayeth him, For his hands have refused to work.

21.he: כָּל־הַ֭יּוֹם הִתְאַוָּ֣ה תַאֲוָ֑ה וְצַדִּ֥יק יִ֝תֵּ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃

lines.text: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
All the day desiring he hath desired, And the righteous giveth and withholdeth not.

21.he: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֵבָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־בְזִמָּ֥ה יְבִיאֶֽנּוּ׃

lines.text: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
The sacrifice of the wicked [is] abomination, Much more when in wickedness he bringeth it.

21.he: עֵד־כְּזָבִ֥ים יֹאבֵ֑ד וְאִ֥ישׁ שׁ֝וֹמֵ֗עַ לָנֶ֥צַח יְדַבֵּֽר׃

lines.text: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.
A false witness doth perish, And an attentive man for ever speaketh.

21.he: הֵעֵ֬ז אִ֣ישׁ רָשָׁ֣ע בְּפָנָ֑יו וְ֝יָשָׁ֗ר ה֤וּא ׀ יכין דרכיו׃

lines.text: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
A wicked man hath hardened by his face, And the upright — he prepareth his way.

21.he: אֵ֣ין חָ֭כְמָה וְאֵ֣ין תְּבוּנָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין עֵ֝צָ֗ה לְנֶ֣גֶד יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
There is no wisdom, nor understanding, Nor counsel, over-against Jehovah.

21.he: ס֗וּס מ֭וּכָן לְי֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְ֝לַֽיהוָ֗ה הַתְּשׁוּעָֽה׃

lines.text: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
A horse is prepared for a day of battle, And the deliverance [is] of Jehovah!

22.he: נִבְחָ֣ר שֵׁ֭ם מֵעֹ֣שֶׁר רָ֑ב מִכֶּ֥סֶף וּ֝מִזָּהָ֗ב חֵ֣ן טֽוֹב׃

lines.text: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
A name is chosen rather than much wealth, Than silver and than gold — good grace.

22.he: עָשִׁ֣יר וָרָ֣שׁ נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ עֹשֵׂ֖ה כֻלָּ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃

lines.text: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.
Rich and poor have met together, The Maker of them all [is] Jehovah.

22.he: עָר֤וּם ׀ רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה ויסתר וּ֝פְתָיִ֗ים עָבְר֥וּ וְֽנֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃

lines.text: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
The prudent hath seen the evil, and is hidden, And the simple have passed on, and are punished.

22.he: עֵ֣קֶב עֲ֭נָוָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְכָב֣וֹד וְחַיִּֽים׃

lines.text: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.
The end of humility [is] the fear of Jehovah, Riches, and honour, and life.

22.he: צִנִּ֣ים פַּ֭חִים בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עִקֵּ֑שׁ שׁוֹמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ יִרְחַ֥ק מֵהֶֽם׃

lines.text: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked: whoever guards his soul stays from them.
Thorns — snares [are] in the way of the perverse, Whoso is keeping his soul is far from them.

22.he: חֲנֹ֣ךְ לַ֭נַּעַר עַל־פִּ֣י דַרְכּ֑וֹ גַּ֥ם כִּֽי־יַ֝זְקִ֗ין לֹֽא־יָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

lines.text: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
Give instruction to a youth about his way, Even when he is old he turneth not from it.

22.he: עָ֭שִׁיר בְּרָשִׁ֣ים יִמְשׁ֑וֹל וְעֶ֥בֶד לֹ֝וֶ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ מַלְוֶֽה׃

lines.text: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
The rich over the poor ruleth, And a servant [is] the borrower to the lender.

22.he: זוֹרֵ֣עַ עַ֭וְלָה יקצור־אָ֑וֶן וְשֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָת֣וֹ יִכְלֶֽה׃

lines.text: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
Whoso is sowing perverseness reapeth sorrow, And the rod of his anger weareth out.

22.he: טֽוֹב־עַ֭יִן ה֣וּא יְבֹרָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־נָתַ֖ן מִלַּחְמ֣וֹ לַדָּֽל׃

lines.text: He who has a generous eye will be blessed; for he shares his food with the poor.
The good of eye — he is blessed, For he hath given of his bread to the poor.

22.he: גָּ֣רֵֽשׁ לֵ֭ץ וְיֵצֵ֣א מָד֑וֹן וְ֝יִשְׁבֹּ֗ת דִּ֣ין וְקָלֽוֹן׃

lines.text: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.
Cast out a scorner — and contention goeth out, And strife and shame cease.

22.he: אֹהֵ֥ב טהור־לֵ֑ב חֵ֥ן שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו רֵעֵ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ׃

lines.text: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
Whoso is loving cleanness of heart, Grace [are] his lips, a king [is] his friend.

22.he: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה נָ֣צְרוּ דָ֑עַת וַ֝יְסַלֵּ֗ף דִּבְרֵ֥י בֹגֵֽד׃

lines.text: Yahweh’s eyes watch over knowledge; but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
The eyes of Jehovah have kept knowledge, And He overthroweth the words of the treacherous.
